## P1 · 数据生命周期

### 20. 没有数据保留 / 归档策略

几张表会单调膨胀：
- `tracking_events`（每封邮件 ≥ 1 open + N click + N unsubscribe candidate）
- `agent_events`（一次 auto-generate 数百条 event）
- `send_logs`（每次发送一封一行）
- `audit_logs`（如果补上）

50w 封/月 × 12 月 × 多条 tracking_event 轻松几千万行。Postgres 单表 > 1 亿行没索引崩溃只是时间问题。

建议：
- 新建 `scripts/retention_sweep.py` CLI：按 table + cutoff 删旧数据（或导到 GCS Parquet 冷备）
- 挂定时任务每天跑；数字典里每张大表配"保留 X 天/年"

### 21. 没有应用层备份 / 数据导出工具

- Cloud SQL 自动备份 ✅（DEPLOY.md §2）
- 但"逻辑备份"（`pg_dump`→GCS 定期冷备）没有剧本
- 运营拿不到"把某个 RecipientList 导出成 CSV"的接口（只有前端个别页能导？未验证）
- 出现 GDPR 删除请求时也没有对应工具（见第 24）

### 22. Unsubscribe 的 race condition

`SendService._send_one_email` 看代码注释会扫 HTML 保退订链接，但**发送前再次查 `Unsubscribe` 表**这件事要确认：
- 场景：用户凌晨 3:00 点退订；4:00 这批 campaign 已经 dispatch 队列好了；4:30 才发到他
- 如果 dispatch 时的 `Unsubscribe` 是预筛选的，4:30 不会再查一次 → 用户仍会收到

建议在 `_send_one_email` 真 `smtp.sendmail` 之前加一次 `SELECT 1 FROM unsubscribes WHERE email=$1 LIMIT 1`（10 万查询也就 10 秒总开销）。

## P1 · CI/CD + 测试

### 23. 完全没有 CI

`.github/workflows/` 目录不存在，`cloudbuild.yaml` 也没有。所有 test / lint / typecheck / build 都靠开发手动跑。必须补：
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`（lint + typecheck + pytest + frontend build）
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`（tag push → build image → push Artifact Registry → trigger Cloud Run deploy）
- 至少把 `npm run build` 和 `pytest edm-backend/` 作为 PR 必过门

### 24. 测试组织散乱

`edm-backend/` 根目录散着：
```
test_api.py  test_broadcast_dedup.py  test_degradation_minimal.py  
test_minimal_csv.py  test_phase17.py  test_reports_overview.py  
test_smtp.py  stress_test_bulk_send.py  stress_test_smtp.py
debug_preview.py
```

- 没有 `tests/` 目录、没有 `conftest.py`、没有 `pyproject.toml` 里的 pytest 配置、没有覆盖率
- 单元/集成/E2E 不分层
- 前端 `package.json` 完全没有 vitest/jest/playwright 依赖，前端 0 单测

建议至少：
- 搬到 `edm-backend/tests/{unit,integration,harness}/`，根目录保留 `conftest.py`
- 把 `stress_test_bulk_send.py` 改成 `tests/harness/stress_bulk_send.py` 并标 `@pytest.mark.slow`
- 前端装 vitest + @testing-library/react，覆盖 login flow / create campaign / send-task 三条关键路径

### 25. 依赖无 lockfile（后端）

`requirements.txt` 用 `>=`，每次部署 `pip install` 可能拉到更高版本导致 CI 绿但生产挂。

建议：
- `pip-tools` 生成 `requirements.lock` 或用 `uv` 生成 `requirements.txt` + pinned 全量
- Renovate/Dependabot 每月自动提依赖升级 PR

### 26. 容器镜像没有漏洞扫描

镜像 push 后没挂 Trivy / Artifact Registry scan / Dependabot，底层 Python 3.11 base image 出 CVE 也没人看。CI 里加 `trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL` 10 分钟搞定。

## P2 · 合规 / 业务完整性

### 27. 没有 GDPR / 个保法响应工具

- "被遗忘权"：没有 `DELETE /api/admin/users/{email}`（级联删 recipient / send_logs / tracking_events / unsubscribes 里的 PII）
- "数据可携权"：没有导出收件人自己的全量数据接口
- 投诉响应 SLA 无法兑现

至少要写一个 `scripts/gdpr_erase.py` CLI：`python -m scripts.gdpr_erase --email foo@bar.com --confirm`，按表级联清理，并留审计日志。

### 28. Consent 记录缺失

`Recipient` 表没有 `consent_source / consent_at / consent_ip` 字段。未来监管问"你这个邮箱从哪来的、何时同意的"→回答不上。下一个 migration 补上这三个字段，`recipient_service.import_csv` 强制要求来源。

### 29. 退订页面品牌/功能缺失

```94:106:edm-backend/app/api/tracking.py
return HTMLResponse(f"""
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Unsubscribe</title></head>
<body style="font-family:sans-serif;text-align:center;padding:60px">
    <h2>Unsubscribe</h2>
    <p>Are you sure you want to unsubscribe (ref: {email_hint})?</p>
    ...
```

- 没有品牌 logo、没有多语言、没有分类退订（只退订 promotion 不退订 transactional）、没有反馈原因
- Gmail / Yahoo 的 bulk sender 合规要求"分类退订"（List-Unsubscribe-Category）
- 建议抽成一个 Jinja 模板 + i18n，按 `tracking_codec` 里的 campaign.category 决定默认勾选项

## P2 · 前端 / 用户体验

### 30. 无全局 Error Boundary + 无 401 统一拦截

- 一旦某个路由组件 throw，整个页面白屏
- 建议：`src/app/ErrorBoundary.tsx` 兜底 + `aiApi.ts` / `api.ts` 的 fetch 包装统一检查 401 → 跳登录

### 31. 无会话超时提醒

JWT 24h 过期（生产改 8h），用户正在编辑 20 分钟后突然 401 → 输入全丢。应该：
- token 即将过期 5 分钟前弹 toast"会话即将超时，是否续期"
- 或者直接做 refresh token 自动续

### 32. 没有版本号展示

用户报 bug 时客服拿不到"你现在用的是 v1.0.3"。在登录页 footer / 设置页 about 弹出来即可，绑定到 `VITE_APP_VERSION`（Docker 里已经传了，前端代码要展示）。

### 33. 缺 Runbook / On-call 指南

`DEPLOY.md §8` 故障排查是一张表格，内容较粗。应该再补一份 `RUNBOOK.md`：
- "凌晨 3 点 spam_rate 突破 0.3%，自动 paused 了一个 campaign" → 操作员怎么看、怎么决定是否 resume、怎么清理坏名单
- "Postmaster Tools domain reputation 变 Low" → 立即做什么
- "Gmail/QQ 某域 bounce_rate 超 5%" → 局部暂停那个域的发送（当前代码有没有这个能力？没有的话补）
- "AI provider 全挂 30 分钟" → 切 provider 的命令、灰度验证

### 34. 缺 Staging 环境 & 金丝雀

- 没有 `.env.staging.example`
- 没有"prod/staging 双部署、staging 验一晚、再切 prod"的 SOP
- Cloud Run 的 `update-traffic --to-revisions X=10,Y=90` 有能力但没脚本化；建议加 `scripts/deploy_canary.sh`

`.env.production.example` 注释提到 `TRACKING_SECRET` 换了会让历史追踪 fail，`JWT_SECRET` 换了会踢掉所有人——但没实现：

### 36. 缺容量模型 / 扩容剧本

- Postgres `db-custom-1-3840` 在 50w 邮件并发下会不会打满？没有基线数据

## 杂项（小坑）

### 37. CSV 导入大文件会 OOM

`recipient_service.import_csv` 用 `pandas.read_csv` 一次性读内存。50w 行 + UTF-8 CSV 大约 500 MB，Cloud Run 1 GiB 内存直接 OOM。改 `chunksize=10000` 流式读。

### 38. `docker-compose.yml::backend` 默认 `SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true` + 单进程

HANDOFF §9.6 已提到，但还是要强调：自托管用户一旦 `docker compose up --scale backend=2` 就会重复触发定时任务。建议在 compose 里加个 `profiles:` 把 scheduler 拆到独立 service，默认 up 时前端+后端+db 起，`--profile worker` 才起 worker（运维明确理解"HA 必须拆 worker"）。

### 39. 工作区根还有 `edm_demo.db` 444 MB + 几个零散 html/png

HANDOFF §7 说 `.gitignore` 已覆盖，但交付前要 `git ls-files | rg "edm_demo|\.log$|\.html$|ai_studio"` 检查一遍（标题里含中文的 html/png 可能被某个 glob 漏掉）。

### 40. `agent_runs` / `agent_events` trace 没分页 purge 工具

trace_store 写入频繁，UI 上却没有"只保留最近 7 天"的清理入口；和第 20 条数据保留一起规划。

## 按 "先修哪一批" 的分批建议

| 批次 | 工作内容 | 估计工时 | 不修的代价 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **第 1 批 · 2 周** | 第 1/2/4/9/10/11/17 项：登录限速、JWT token_version、审计日志、Sentry、DB 连接池、Prometheus metrics | 10 人日 | 被爆破/被拖库后你不知道发生了什么 |
| **第 2 批 · 2 周** | 第 5/13/14/15/19/23/24 项：RBAC 细化、告警、SendQueue 持久化、Webhook 去重、补 `app.scheduler_tick`、CI、测试重组 | 10 人日 | 业务事故无法回溯 + 发布风险大 |
| **第 3 批 · 2 周** | 第 20/21/27/28/33/37 项：数据保留、GDPR 工具、consent 字段、Runbook、CSV 流式读 | 8 人日 | 监管/审计/大名单翻车 |
| **第 4 批 · 持续** | 第 6/7/12/16/18/22/26/30-36/40 项：其余治理类、UX 优化 | 边跑边补 | 不致命但会慢慢累积技术债 |

---

**最后一个主观判断**：当前这套系统的**业务层**（Agent 框架、Harness 三层、发送节奏 / 反指纹 / Postmaster 合规）在国内的 EDM 项目里已经算是相当扎实了，甚至超出很多商业 SaaS。真正"不像一个长期系统"的地方，几乎全在**平台基础建设**上：认证、审计、可观测性、CI、数据生命周期——都是"一次性补完就能用很久"的模块。先把 P0 的安全 + 观测补齐，再谈其他的；否则再多发送策略红线，都挡不住一个没审计日志的误操作。

要我按上面的分批开始动工吗？如果要，我建议先从 **第 1 批的审计日志 + Sentry + DB 连接池 + 登录限速** 四件事开始——这四件都是 independent 的，能并行做，一周内就能见到生产侧的明显变化。

 Now I'm taking stock of the entire system and identifying what needs strengthening for long-term stability. This EDM system is already quite mature—the pre-delivery checklist has caught many obvious issues like CORS, credential exposure, storage problems, and schema drift—but as an internal system meant to run indefinitely, there are still critical gaps in observability, security, reliability, and maintainability that need addressing.

Looking at the security side first, which is the most urgent: the login endpoint has no rate limiting or account lockout after failed attempts, making it vulnerable to brute force attacks even in an internal network. JWT tokens can't be revoked once issued since there's no blacklist or token versioning mechanism, so when someone leaves or their credentials are compromised, those tokens remain valid until expiration. There's also no password policy enforcement during registration, no way to force password changes, and no meaningful logout functionality. Beyond that, there's a complete absence of audit logging—which is essential for an internal system—so there's no record of who logged in, what campaigns were created, when send tasks were triggered, or when large contact lists were imported.

The role-based access control is too coarse with just admin and operator levels, meaning anyone with operator access can launch campaigns affecting hundreds of thousands of emails without any approval workflow. Sensitive data like email addresses are stored in plaintext, creating massive PII exposure risk if there's ever a data breach. Security headers are incomplete—there's no CSP, HSTS, or Permissions-Policy, and the tracking endpoints are completely open and unthrottled.

Now I'm looking at the tracking endpoint security more carefully—the signature verification seems incomplete, and even if signing is in place, malicious actors could spam valid payloads to corrupt the open/click metrics. On the observability side, there's no APM or error tracking integrated despite having exception logging throughout the code, so production issues require manual log digging. There are no metrics endpoints or alerting rules for critical failures like SMTP connection issues, AI provider rate limits, or database problems.

The health check endpoint is too basic—it doesn't actually verify database or Redis connectivity, and there's no separation between readiness and liveness probes. Logging is unstructured plain text instead of JSON, which means Cloud Logging can't properly index it, and there's no request tracing with correlation IDs across the system.

For reliability, the webhook handler lacks idempotency protection and deduplication for retried events, so duplicate bounce/unsubscribe messages could corrupt state. The send queue is just an in-memory asyncio queue that loses messages if the worker crashes, and while there's retry logic, there's no persistent dead letter queue for failed messages.

The AI provider integration has no circuit breaker pattern, so if DeepSeek goes down, every request still waits through all three retries before failing—there's also no runtime fallback to switch to OpenAI. Database connections aren't pooled with proper sizing or health checks, which means the service could deadlock under load. Graceful shutdown isn't implemented, so in-flight emails get interrupted when Cloud Run sends SIGTERM, and there's no clear disaster recovery runbook or chaos engineering tests.

For data integrity, the tracking and event tables grow unbounded with no retention or archival policy, and unsubscribe operations aren't atomic with email dispatch—a user could unsubscribe while a campaign is mid-send. There's also no cold backup strategy beyond Cloud SQL's automatic backups, and no operational tools for on-demand exports.

On the frontend side, there's no global error boundary to catch crashes, no session timeout warning before the JWT expires and loses user input, and the production build doesn't embed version information so users can't report which build they're running.

For maintainability, there's no CI/CD pipeline at all—no automated testing, linting, or image builds. Tests are scattered across the backend root directory with no organization, fixtures, or coverage tracking, and the frontend has zero test infrastructure. Dependency management is also loose with `requirements.txt` using flexible version constraints instead of a lockfile, risking unexpected breaking changes in production.

Key operational gaps include missing documentation for secret rotation workflows—JWT and tracking secrets need careful handling, and API key rotation should use parallel keys with versioning but isn't implemented. The deployment script references a scheduler module that doesn't appear to exist, which could block operations.

On compliance, there's no multi-tenant isolation despite what seems to be internal cross-department usage, so data visibility isn't restricted. GDPR and data protection compliance tooling is completely absent—no way to handle user deletion requests or data exports. Consent records aren't being tracked either, which is a critical gap for regulatory requirements.

The unsubscribe flow is minimal and lacks branding, categorized preferences, and feedback collection. For deployment, there's no staging environment definition or documented process, no automation for blue-green or canary deployments despite Cloud Run supporting it, and no capacity planning guidelines for scaling decisions. The troubleshooting documentation exists but is too sparse to be actionable.

Looking at the remaining issues: there are specific runbooks missing for common failure scenarios like SES outages or API rate limits, plus no on-call training materials. The codebase has performance risks with CSV handling that could cause memory issues, a large demo database file that shouldn't be in the handoff, test scripts scattered outside the standard pytest structure, and missing frontend error handling like ErrorBoundary and global 401 interception. There's also no error tracking integration, the Docker setup defaults to HTTP and in-process scheduling which breaks at scale, and no load testing infrastructure to validate capacity assumptions.

Now I'm organizing these findings into a prioritized assessment for the user, starting with security and observability as the critical foundations, then reliability, CI/CD, compliance, and operational concerns in order of impact.

 The user has settled on the most disruptive path: switching to Cloud Tasks for job dispatch, removing that section from the deployment docs, and building a custom circuit breaker from scratch. Now I'm diving deeper into how Cloud Tasks will actually work for this use case.

The core shift is moving away from the in-memory queue—instead, each SendLog gets enqueued as a separate Cloud Tasks task with its log ID as the payload, and Cloud Tasks handles the HTTP callbacks to trigger the actual email dispatch logic. The tricky part is rethinking the three-tier rate limiting: Cloud Tasks has its own rate controls that could replace the global bucket, but per-domain and per-variant limits need separate queues, and the warmup ramp plus feedback loop become more complex since I'd need background jobs periodically adjusting Cloud Tasks' dispatch rates through its API.

On the practical side, Cloud Tasks guarantees at-least-once delivery with exponential backoff and dead-letter handling, which is solid for reliability. The cost model is tight though—the free tier covers a million tasks monthly, and a 500k campaign burns through half that in one run. For local development, I'd need either a Cloud Tasks emulator or a fallback to the in-process queue.

This is a substantial rewrite of the core dispatch logic in `send_service.py`, and I should confirm with the user whether they want to keep the warmup and feedback mechanisms or simplify by letting Cloud Tasks handle all rate limiting, plus how to handle local development and self-hosted setups.

Looking at the actual scope: I'd need to replace the send task processor with Cloud Tasks enqueueing, add a new endpoint for Cloud Tasks callbacks, and redesign the rate limiting around Cloud Tasks queues. The three-tier rate limiting (per-domain, per-variant, global) would map to separate queues—with 3-8 variants and 9 domains, that's up to 72 queues shared across campaigns. For local development, I'd add a backend switch to keep asyncio.Queue as a fallback.

The batch optimization for SMTP (sending 20 emails per connection) breaks down here since Cloud Tasks delivers one email per callback, so I'd need to either include batch IDs in the payload and fetch related emails server-side, or group 20 emails into a single enqueue operation. This batching is critical to the current 50w-in-4h throughput, so losing it would be a real performance hit.

I'm realizing there might be two different interpretations of what the user wants: either Cloud Tasks just orchestrates SendTask-level scheduling (keeping the internal queue and worker pool), or it handles individual emails. The first approach is minimal—just swap out how tasks get triggered—but doesn't give true email-level persistence. The second is architecturally cleaner but requires 2-3 weeks of work and careful cost planning. I'm leaning toward clarifying which direction makes sense before committing to a plan.

SQLite\n     result = await db.execute(stmt)\n     if result.rowcount == 0:\n         return {\"status\": \"skipped_duplicate\", \"event_id\": event_id}\n     ``​`\n\n**边界**：Tencent payload 实测 event_id 可能缺失（控制台生成的 webhook 不一定带 event_id），合成 fallback 必须够稳定。\n\n---\n\n## 阶段 4 · #16 AI Provider 断路器 + 运行时切换\n\n**新增/改 4 个文件**：\n\n### 4.1 新 `app/ai_providers/circuit_breaker.py`（~80 行）\n\n三态机：`closed` → `open`（滑动窗口连续 ≥ N 次失败）→ `half_open`（冷却后放 1 探测请求）。失败定义：`httpx.TimeoutException` / `httpx.HTTPStatusError` 5xx / `ValueError` empty choices。\n\n关键字段：`failure_threshold=5` / `window_size=10` / `cooldown_seconds=60`。断路打开时抛 `CircuitOpenError`。\n\n### 4.2 改 [app/ai_providers/__init__.py](edm-backend/app/ai_providers/__init__.py)\n\n- 包装 provider：`_ProviderProxy(primary, fallback, breaker)`，`chat_completion*` 先进 breaker，命中 `CircuitOpenError` 自动路由到 fallback provider\n- 新增 `swap_provider(role: Literal[\"content\", \"translate\"], name: str, model: str) -> None`：原子替换模块级单例 + 老 provider `close()`\n- `get_*_provider()` 返回 `_ProviderProxy`\n\n### 4.3 新 [app/api/admin.py](edm-backend/app/api/admin.py)（如果还不存在）\n\n``​`\nPOST /api/admin/ai/swap-provider\nBody: {\"role\": \"content\"|\"translate\", \"provider\": \"...\", \"model\": \"...\"}\nAuth: admin role only\n``​`\n\n### 4.4 [app/config.py](edm-backend/app/config.py) 补\n\n``​`python\nAI_CONTENT_FALLBACK_PROVIDER: str = \"\"      # 为空 = 不 fallback\nAI_CONTENT_FALLBACK_MODEL: str = \"\"\nAI_TRANSLATE_FALLBACK_PROVIDER: str = \"\"\nAI_TRANSLATE_FALLBACK_MODEL: str = \"\"\nAI_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ENABLED: bool = True\nAI_CB_FAILURE_THRESHOLD: int = 5\nAI_CB_WINDOW_SIZE: int = 10\nAI_CB_COOLDOWN_SECONDS: int = 60\n``​`\n\n---\n\n## 阶段 5 · #18 优雅关闭 + kill -9 smoke\n\n### 5.1 改 [app/services/send_service.py](edm-backend/app/services/send_service.py)\n\n`_process_send_task` 外层（1120-1297 行附近）加 `asyncio.CancelledError` 捕获：\n\n``​`python\ntry:\n    # ... existing body ...\nexcept asyncio.CancelledError:\n    async with async_session_factory() as db:\n        task = await db.get(SendTask, task_id)\n        if task and task.status == \"sending\":\n            task.status = \"paused\"\n            task.error_message = \"Graceful shutdown — auto-resume on next worker boot\"\n            await db.commit()\n    raise\n``​`\n\n已有的 `pause_flag` 路径（1280-1295 行）会走 `_persist_partial_progress` flush 已发成功的 sent 计数 → 下次启动 resume 时只补剩余 pending logs。\n\n### 5.2 改 [app/worker.py](edm-backend/app/worker.py)\n\n`main()` shutdown 阶段（92-95 行附近）：\n- 先取消所有 `send_service.execute_send_task` 衍生的协程（`asyncio.all_tasks()` 过滤 name prefix）\n- `await asyncio.wait_for(gather(..., return_exceptions=True), timeout=8.0)` 留 2s buffer 给 Cloud Run 10s grace\n- **启动时** 扫一次 `SELECT id FROM send_tasks WHERE status IN ('sending','paused')` → 逐个 `execute_send_task(id)`（arrival 检测，防孤儿），走的是已有的 \"resumed=True\" 路径\n\n### 5.3 新 [edm-backend/scripts/smoke_kill_recovery.py](edm-backend/scripts/smoke_kill_recovery.py)\n\n独立脚本（非 pytest）：\n1. MockSES 后端 + 10 k SendLog\n2. 后台启 worker 进程\n3. 监控 `sent >= 500`\n4. 发 SIGTERM（不是 SIGKILL，先测 graceful；再跑一轮 SIGKILL 强杀）\n5. sleep 3s\n6. 重新 spawn worker\n7. 期望：10s 内最终 `sent=10000, failed=0`\n8. 写 NDJSON 证据到 `debug-kill-recovery.log`\n\n---\n\n## 阶段 6 · #14 Cloud Tasks task-level\n\n### 6.1 抽象 trigger\n\n**新 [app/services/dispatch_trigger.py](edm-backend/app/services/dispatch_trigger.py)**：\n\n``​`python\nclass DispatchTrigger(Protocol):\n    async def enqueue(self, task_id: str, *, delay_seconds: int = 0) -> None: ...\n\nclass BackgroundTaskTrigger:  # local + docker-compose\n    async def enqueue(self, task_id, *, delay_seconds=0):\n        from app.services.send_service import send_service\n        asyncio.create_task(_delayed(task_id, delay_seconds, send_service.execute_send_task))\n\nclass CloudTasksTrigger:  # production GCP\n    def __init__(self, project, region, queue, callback_base, oidc_sa):\n        from google.cloud import tasks_v2\n        self._client = tasks_v2.CloudTasksAsyncClient()\n        # ...\n    async def enqueue(self, task_id, *, delay_seconds=0):\n        task = {\n            \"http_request\": {\n                \"http_method\": \"POST\",\n                \"url\": f\"{self._callback_base}/api/internal/tasks/dispatch/{task_id}\",\n                \"oidc_token\": {\"service_account_email\": self._oidc_sa},\n            },\n            \"schedule_time\": ... if delay_seconds > 0 else None,\n        }\n        await self._client.create_task(parent=self._queue_path, task=task)\n\ndef get_dispatch_trigger() -> DispatchTrigger: ...  # 按 settings.SEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND 选\n``​`\n\n### 6.2 回调入口\n\n**新 [app/api/internal_tasks.py](edm-backend/app/api/internal_tasks.py)**：\n\n``​`python\n@router.post(\"/internal/tasks/dispatch/{task_id}\")\nasync def dispatch_callback(\n    task_id: str,\n    request: Request,\n    _cloud_task: None = Depends(verify_cloud_tasks_oidc),\n):\n    \"\"\"Cloud Tasks 回调 → 触发 execute_send_task。\n\n    幂等性：execute_send_task 接收 queued/preparing/paused，\n    正在 sending 的 task 直接 return 200 让 Cloud Tasks 不 retry。\n    kill -9 场景：Cloud Tasks 默认 10 min 超时，超时自动 retry 到另一\n    个 worker 实例（配合 stage 5 的 startup orphan scan，最坏 10 min 续传）。\n    \"\"\"\n    from app.services.send_service import send_service\n    async with async_session_factory() as db:\n        task = await db.get(SendTask, task_id)\n        if not task:\n            return {\"status\": \"not_found\"}\n        if task.status == \"sending\":\n            # 另一个实例在跑，别抢\n            return {\"status\": \"already_running\"}\n    try:\n        await send_service.execute_send_task(task_id)\n        return {\"status\": \"completed\"}\n    except Exception:\n        logger.exception(\"dispatch callback failed | task=%s\", task_id)\n        raise HTTPException(500)   # 让 Cloud Tasks retry\n``​`\n\n`verify_cloud_tasks_oidc`：校验 `Authorization: Bearer <OIDC JWT>` 签名 + audience 是 callback URL。本地 backend 走 `background_task` 时这层直接 no-op。\n\n### 6.3 替换 4 处调用点\n\n把 `background_tasks.add_task(send_service.execute_send_task, task.id)` 换成 `await get_dispatch_trigger().enqueue(task.id)`：\n\n- [app/api/send_tasks.py:157](edm-backend/app/api/send_tasks.py)（retry）\n- [app/api/send_tasks.py:265](edm-backend/app/api/send_tasks.py)（pause resume）\n- [app/api/campaigns_send.py:107](edm-backend/app/api/campaigns_send.py)（立刻发送）\n- [app/api/campaigns_send.py:310](edm-backend/app/api/campaigns_send.py)（第二处发送入口）\n- [app/services/scheduler.py:84](edm-backend/app/services/scheduler.py)（scheduled_at 到期）同样换成 enqueue\n\n### 6.4 配置 + 依赖\n\n[requirements.txt](edm-backend/requirements.txt) 加：\n``​`\ngoogle-cloud-tasks>=2.16\n``​`\n\n[app/config.py](edm-backend/app/config.py) 加：\n``​`python\nSEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND: str = \"background_task\"  # cloud_tasks / background_task\nGCP_PROJECT_ID: str = \"\"\nGCP_REGION: str = \"\"\nCLOUD_TASKS_QUEUE_NAME: str = \"edm-send-tasks\"\nCLOUD_TASKS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL: str = \"\"   # https://edm-worker-xxx.a.run.app\nCLOUD_TASKS_OIDC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: str = \"\"\n``​`\n\n### 6.5 文档\n\n[DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md) §3 新增 \"3.5 Cloud Tasks 队列建法\"：\n\n``​`bash\ngcloud tasks queues create edm-send-tasks \\\n  --location=$REGION \\\n  --max-dispatches-per-second=5 \\\n  --max-concurrent-dispatches=3 \\\n  --max-attempts=5 \\\n  --min-backoff=10s --max-backoff=300s\n``​`\n\n---\n\n## 数据流图（#14 task-level）\n\n``​`mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    A[API: POST /send-tasks] --> B[create_send_task]\n    B --> C[SendTask.status=queued]\n    C --> D[dispatch_trigger.enqueue]\n    D --> E{SEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND?}\n    E -->|background_task| F[asyncio.create_task]\n    E -->|cloud_tasks| G[Cloud Tasks queue]\n    G --> H[POST /api/internal/tasks/dispatch/:id]\n    H --> I{current status}\n    I -->|sending| J[200 already_running]\n    I -->|queued/paused| K[execute_send_task]\n    F --> K\n    K --> L[_process_send_task worker pool]\n    L -->|SIGTERM| M[CancelledError handler]\n    M --> N[SendTask.status=paused]\n    N --> O[Cloud Tasks 10min timeout -> retry]\n    O --> H\n``​`\n\n---\n\n## 硬红线（不能碰）\n\n- 营销/事务 From 分流、SPF/DKIM/DMARC 体检、退订链接覆盖率、变体反指纹 —— 这次所有改动都在 SendService **外层**（何时触发 + 崩溃恢复），不碰这些现有硬门\n- `_pick_variant_idx` / 三级令牌桶 / warmup ramp / feedback loop：保持不变\n- `execute_send_task` 的 resume 语义已经存在（支持 `queued/preparing/paused`），我们只是扩展触发源\n\n## 文档同步\n\n- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 不改（SendService 对外语义没变）\n- [HANDOFF_CHECKLIST.md](HANDOFF_CHECKLIST.md) 各条 ❌ 改 ✅，附改动 commit hash\n- [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md) §3.4 删、§3.5 加、§8.3 同步\n\n",

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\models\\webhook_event.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"Webhook idempotency ledger.\n\nTencent Cloud SES **will** redeliver webhook events to us: any 5xx we\nreturn (even transient), any >10s latency, or any network hiccup on\ntheir side triggers a retry. Same goes for Gmail's List-Unsubscribe\ncallbacks or any other third-party event source we might add later.\n\nWithout de-duplication the same ``bounce`` event gets recorded twice\nin ``tracking_events``, which doubles ``bounce_rate`` in the Phase 3\nfeedback loop and can trigger unnecessary down-scales. Worse, the\n``SendLog`` status update runs again and flips a bounced row to\n\"bounced again\"; the ``unsubscribes`` table gets a second \"auto:\nbounce\" row rejected with a unique-violation log line that's hard to\ndistinguish from a real replay attack.\n\nSolution: every inbound webhook event is keyed to a stable\n``event_id`` (either the source's own id, or a deterministic\ncomposition when the source doesn't supply one). We attempt an insert\n*before* any side-effecting work; if the insert conflicts, the\nhandler short-circuits to `skipped_duplicate` and returns 200. See\n``app/services/webhook_service.py::process_tencent_event`` for the\nactual gate.\n\nThe table also stores a SHA-256 of the normalised payload — useful\nfor two reasons:\n  1. Diagnosing replay attacks: if the event_id matches but the hash\n     doesn't, something upstream is re-signing events with the same\n     id. Fallout: log + quarantine.\n  2. After-the-fact audits: operators can prove \"yes, we did receive\n     exactly this payload\" without keeping the raw JSON around (which\n     would bloat the table unbounded).\n\nRetention: not enforced in code. Operators should TRUNCATE or drop\nrows older than 30 days via a periodic job if the table gets large;\nat normal Tencent SES throughputs (≤ 10 events/sec) the annual row\ncount is well under what Postgres can handle on a plain btree index.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nfrom sqlalchemy import DateTime, Index, String\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column\n\nfrom app.models.base import Base\n\n\nclass WebhookEvent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"webhook_events\"\n    __table_args__ = (\n        # Unique event id per source — the idempotency key. Deliberately\n        # NOT the primary key so we inherit ``Base.id`` (UUID hex) for\n        # consistency with every other table; the dedup invariant is\n        # carried by this unique index instead, which ON CONFLICT /\n        # OR IGNORE can target directly.\n        Index(\n            \"uq_webhook_events_source_event_id\",\n            \"source\",\n            \"event_id\",\n            unique=True,\n        ),\n        # Support \"events received in the last N minutes\" monitor\n        # queries without scanning the full table.\n        Index(\n            \"ix_webhook_events_source_received\",\n            \"source\",\n            \"received_at\",\n        ),\n    )\n\n    # \"tencent_ses\" today; any future webhook source (Sendgrid, Gmail,\n    # Mailgun…) gets its own constant so the namespace for event_id\n    # never collides.\n    source: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)\n\n    # Upstream-supplied id OR composed fallback. See\n    # ``webhook_service._derive_event_id`` for the composition rule.\n    # 128 chars is enough for any realistic combination of bulkId +\n    # event + timestamp.\n    event_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)\n\n    # sha256 hex of the normalised payload. Kept separate from raw\n    # JSON so the table stays compact; a replay-attack investigation\n    # can compare two hashes without needing the original body.\n    payload_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)\n\n    # ``created_at`` (from Base) records the insert moment; this field\n    # records when we *first saw* the event. They'll match for live\n    # traffic but diverge if we back-fill the table from logs.\n    received_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(\n        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False\n    )\n\n    # Set by the handler after the side-effecting work succeeds.\n    # Staying null means \"inserted but never finished processing\" —\n    # useful for operators to find events that crashed mid-flight.\n    processed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(\n        DateTime(timezone=True)\n    )\n"
}

 "new_string": "async def _locate_send_log(\n    db: AsyncSession, bulk_id: str\n) -> tuple[SendLog | None, str]:\n    \"\"\"Find SendLog + parent campaign_id that matches a Tencent bulkId.\"\"\"\n    if not bulk_id:\n        return None, \"\"\n    result = await db.execute(\n        select(SendLog, SendTask.campaign_id)\n        .join(SendTask, SendTask.id == SendLog.task_id)\n        .where(SendLog.ses_message_id == bulk_id)\n    )\n    row = result.first()\n    if not row:\n        return None, \"\"\n    send_log, campaign_id = row\n    return send_log, campaign_id or \"\"\n\n\ndef _derive_event_id(event: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a stable idempotency key for a Tencent SES event.\n\n    Preference order:\n      1. Explicit upstream id: ``event_id`` or ``eventId`` field.\n      2. Composed fallback: ``<bulkId>:<event>:<timestamp>`` — stable\n         because Tencent redelivers the exact same payload on retry.\n\n    The composed fallback is intentionally tolerant of missing fields\n    (an empty component just becomes ``::``); a single such event is\n    still unique within the (bulkId, event_type) space for the same\n    send. Two legitimately different events with the same bulk_id +\n    event_type + timestamp shouldn't exist in practice — Tencent's own\n    delivery pipeline keys on that triple.\n\n    Length cap matches the ORM column (128 chars). We prefer truncate-\n    then-suffix-hash over rejecting the event, because rejecting would\n    silently drop real tracking data.\n    \"\"\"\n    for key in (\"event_id\", \"eventId\"):\n        raw = event.get(key)\n        if raw:\n            candidate = str(raw)\n            return candidate if len(candidate) <= 128 else f\"{candidate[:120]}:{hashlib.sha1(candidate.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}\"\n\n    bulk_id = event.get(\"bulkId\") or event.get(\"bulkid\") or \"\"\n    raw_event = (event.get(\"event\") or \"\").strip().lower()\n    # Tencent uses ``timestamp`` (ms since epoch) consistently; we\n    # accept a couple of common aliases just in case an intermediate\n    # gateway rewrites the key.\n    ts = (\n        event.get(\"timestamp\")\n        or event.get(\"event_time\")\n        or event.get(\"eventTime\")\n        or \"\"\n    )\n    composed = f\"{bulk_id}:{raw_event}:{ts}\"\n    return composed if len(composed) <= 128 else f\"{composed[:120]}:{hashlib.sha1(composed.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}\"\n\n\ndef _compute_payload_hash(event: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"sha256 hex of the normalised event payload.\n\n    ``sort_keys=True`` keeps the hash stable across dict ordering\n    differences between Python versions / Tencent gateway nodes. We\n    skip ``default=str`` because Tencent payloads are plain JSON —\n    anything non-serialisable is a bug upstream, and raising here\n    surfaces it loudly instead of silently corrupting the hash.\n    \"\"\"\n    raw = json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)\n    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n\nasync def _register_event(\n    db: AsyncSession, *, event_id: str, payload_hash: str\n) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Attempt to register this event in ``webhook_events`` — idempotently.\n\n    Returns ``True`` when this is the first time we see the event\n    (caller should proceed with side-effecting work), ``False`` when\n    the (source, event_id) pair already exists (caller should return\n    early with ``skipped_duplicate``).\n\n    We dispatch on the bind's dialect so the SQL stays native — the\n    Postgres path uses ``ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`` against the unique\n    index, and the SQLite path uses ``INSERT OR IGNORE`` via the\n    dialect-agnostic ``prefix_with`` hook. Both return rowcount=0\n    when the row was already present.\n    \"\"\"\n    bind = db.get_bind()\n    dialect = bind.dialect.name if bind is not None else \"\"\n\n    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n    values = {\n        \"source\": _TENCENT_SOURCE,\n        \"event_id\": event_id,\n        \"payload_hash\": payload_hash,\n        \"received_at\": now,\n    }\n\n    if dialect == \"postgresql\":\n        stmt = pg_insert(WebhookEvent).values(**values).on_conflict_do_nothing(\n            index_elements=[\"source\", \"event_id\"],\n        )\n    else:\n        # SQLite (aiosqlite) + any other dialect: rely on the unique\n        # index + OR IGNORE. ``OR IGNORE`` is a no-op on dialects that\n        # don't support it (they'll raise an IntegrityError instead,\n        # which we treat the same as \"duplicate\").\n        stmt = insert(WebhookEvent).values(**values).prefix_with(\"OR IGNORE\")\n\n    try:\n        result = await db.execute(stmt)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        # IntegrityError on a unique violation is the third-party\n        # equivalent of \"already processed\"; any other error is real\n        # and should propagate.\n        from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError\n\n        if isinstance(exc, IntegrityError):\n            logger.debug(\n                \"webhook dedup insert hit unique violation — treating as duplicate | event_id=%s\",\n                event_id,\n            )\n            return False\n        raise\n\n    # ``rowcount`` for ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING / OR IGNORE is:\n    #   - Postgres (asyncpg): 1 if inserted, 0 if conflict\n    #   - SQLite (aiosqlite): 1 if inserted, 0 if ignored\n    # SQLAlchemy normalises this for both dialects.\n    return (result.rowcount or 0) > 0\n\n\nasync def _mark_event_processed(\n    db: AsyncSession, *, event_id: str, source: str = _TENCENT_SOURCE\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Set ``processed_at`` on the dedup row after side effects succeed.\n\n    Intentionally separate from :func:`_register_event` so a crash\n    between the two leaves the row as \"inserted but not processed\" —\n    operators can grep for those and decide whether to replay.\n    \"\"\"\n    await db.execute(\n        update(WebhookEvent)\n        .where(\n            WebhookEvent.source == source, WebhookEvent.event_id == event_id\n        )\n        .values(processed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc))\n    )"

 "contents": "\"\"\"Async circuit breaker for AI providers.\n\nHANDOFF §16 — when DeepSeek (or any other provider) stalls, every new\nrequest spends ``AI_TIMEOUT=120s`` × ``AI_MAX_RETRIES=3`` before\nsurfacing the failure, which is what makes users think \"AI is stuck\"\nduring an incident. The breaker short-circuits this: once a provider\nhas failed N times inside a small window, every subsequent call\nreturns *immediately* (either via a fallback provider or a\n``CircuitOpenError``). After a cool-down it probes with a single\nrequest; if it succeeds the breaker closes again.\n\nThis file is a deliberately simple ~100-line state machine. It does\n**not** try to compete with pybreaker — we'd rather own 100 lines we\ncan reason about than pull in a mostly-synchronous dependency and\nwrap every call. The coverage matches what a realistic incident\nneeds:\n\n  * a rolling window of the last N calls (default 10)\n  * \"open\" when the failure count in that window hits a threshold\n  * a cool-down during which every call short-circuits\n  * \"half-open\" after the cool-down: exactly **one** request is let\n    through to probe; success closes the breaker, failure re-opens it\n\nThe ``asyncio.Lock`` keeps the window + state transitions coherent\nunder concurrent callers without serialising the actual request (the\nlock is released before we await the provider call). Counters are\natomic under the lock; the probe-slot is a single boolean guarded by\nthe same lock.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport collections\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Awaitable, Callable, TypeVar\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"ai.circuit_breaker\")\n\nT = TypeVar(\"T\")\n\n\nclass CircuitState(Enum):\n    CLOSED = \"closed\"\n    OPEN = \"open\"\n    HALF_OPEN = \"half_open\"\n\n\nclass CircuitOpenError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the breaker is open and no fallback is available.\n\n    Callers should treat this as a *fast* failure — no retry, no\n    timeout — and either surface it to the user or route to a\n    fallback provider.\n    \"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CircuitBreaker:\n    \"\"\"Rolling-window circuit breaker guarding an async callable.\n\n    Attributes:\n        name: Human-readable identifier for logs / metrics — e.g.\n            ``\"deepseek/chat\"``. Not used for state keying; one\n            breaker instance = one tracked dependency.\n        failure_threshold: Number of failures inside ``window_size``\n            that flip the breaker to OPEN. Default 5 / 10 == 50 %.\n        window_size: Rolling window length (in calls). Older calls\n            fall off the deque.\n        cooldown_seconds: Wall-clock pause between OPEN and\n            HALF_OPEN. Defaults to 60 s — short enough that a flaky\n            provider recovers quickly, long enough that we don't\n            hammer it during a real outage.\n        enabled: Hard off switch for tests / rollback. When False,\n            every call passes through unchanged.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    name: str\n    failure_threshold: int = 5\n    window_size: int = 10\n    cooldown_seconds: float = 60.0\n    enabled: bool = True\n\n    _state: CircuitState = field(default=CircuitState.CLOSED, init=False)\n    _window: collections.deque[bool] = field(init=False)\n    _opened_at: float = field(default=0.0, init=False)\n    _probe_in_flight: bool = field(default=False, init=False)\n    _lock: asyncio.Lock = field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock, init=False)\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        self._window = collections.deque(maxlen=max(self.window_size, 1))\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Introspection (for /health, tests, admin UI)\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    @property\n    def state(self) -> CircuitState:\n        return self._state\n\n    def snapshot(self) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"name\": self.name,\n            \"state\": self._state.value,\n            \"enabled\": self.enabled,\n            \"failures_in_window\": sum(1 for ok in self._window if not ok),\n            \"window_size\": len(self._window),\n            \"opened_at\": self._opened_at if self._state is not CircuitState.CLOSED else None,\n        }\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Core gate\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def call(self, fn: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:\n        \"\"\"Run ``fn`` through the breaker. Raises :class:`CircuitOpenError`\n        without invoking ``fn`` when the breaker is open and no probe\n        slot is available.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.enabled:\n            return await fn()\n\n        # Decide whether we're allowed to run at all, and whether we\n        # hold the probe slot. The lock serialises this bit; the\n        # actual ``fn()`` call happens *outside* the lock.\n        allow, is_probe = await self._enter()\n        if not allow:\n            raise CircuitOpenError(\n                f\"Circuit breaker '{self.name}' is OPEN \"\n                f\"(cooldown remaining ~{self._cooldown_remaining():.1f}s)\"\n            )\n\n        try:\n            result = await fn()\n        except Exception as exc:\n            await self._record(False, is_probe=is_probe)\n            logger.warning(\n                \"circuit_breaker: call failed | name=%s state=%s error=%s\",\n                self.name, self._state.value, type(exc).__name__,\n            )\n            raise\n        else:\n            await self._record(True, is_probe=is_probe)\n            return result\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # State transitions\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _enter(self) -> tuple[bool, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Pre-call gate. Returns ``(allow, is_probe)``.\n\n        * CLOSED → always allow, not a probe\n        * OPEN   → if cooldown elapsed: transition to HALF_OPEN and\n                  grant the probe slot; otherwise reject\n        * HALF_OPEN → grant probe slot if none in flight, reject\n                      otherwise (we only want *one* in-flight probe)\n        \"\"\"\n        async with self._lock:\n            if self._state is CircuitState.CLOSED:\n                return True, False\n\n            now = time.monotonic()\n            if self._state is CircuitState.OPEN:\n                if now - self._opened_at < self.cooldown_seconds:\n                    return False, False\n                # Cooldown elapsed — slide into HALF_OPEN and grant\n                # the caller the probe slot.\n                self._state = CircuitState.HALF_OPEN\n                self._probe_in_flight = True\n                logger.info(\n                    \"circuit_breaker: OPEN → HALF_OPEN (probe granted) | name=%s\",\n                    self.name,\n                )\n                return True, True\n\n            # HALF_OPEN\n            if self._probe_in_flight:\n                return False, False\n            self._probe_in_flight = True\n            return True, True\n\n    async def _record(self, ok: bool, *, is_probe: bool) -> None:\n        async with self._lock:\n            self._window.append(ok)\n\n            if is_probe:\n                # The probe's verdict drives the next transition.\n                self._probe_in_flight = False\n                if ok:\n                    self._state = CircuitState.CLOSED\n                    self._window.clear()\n                    logger.info(\n                        \"circuit_breaker: HALF_OPEN → CLOSED | name=%s\",\n                        self.name,\n                    )\n                else:\n                    self._state = CircuitState.OPEN\n                    self._opened_at = time.monotonic()\n                    logger.warning(\n                        \"circuit_breaker: HALF_OPEN → OPEN (probe failed) | name=%s\",\n                        self.name,\n                    )\n                return\n\n            # Non-probe call. Count failures in window and maybe trip.\n            if not ok and self._state is CircuitState.CLOSED:\n                failures = sum(1 for v in self._window if not v)\n                if failures >= self.failure_threshold:\n                    self._state = CircuitState.OPEN\n                    self._opened_at = time.monotonic()\n                    logger.error(\n                        \"circuit_breaker: CLOSED → OPEN | name=%s failures=%d/%d\",\n                        self.name, failures, len(self._window),\n                    )\n\n    def _cooldown_remaining(self) -> float:\n        if self._state is not CircuitState.OPEN:\n            return 0.0\n        return max(0.0, self.cooldown_seconds - (time.monotonic() - self._opened_at))\n\n    def reset(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Force the breaker back to CLOSED. Used by admin swap.\n\n        We explicitly don't take the lock here — callers should only\n        invoke this while no other code is using the breaker (e.g.\n        right after swapping the provider instance out). Taking the\n        lock would require awaiting, which makes the reset behaviour\n        inconsistent with its documented \"sync, immediate\" semantics.\n        \"\"\"\n        self._state = CircuitState.CLOSED\n        self._window.clear()\n        self._opened_at = 0.0\n        self._probe_in_flight = False\n"

The periodic :func:`check_stale_tasks`\n      (5 min tick) would eventually flip it to ``failed``, but that's\n      the wrong action here: a fresh worker *can* continue the send.\n\n    Both cases land on the same recovery path: flip ``sending`` rows\n    back to ``paused`` (so the existing resume logic kicks in) and\n    then call :meth:`SendService.execute_send_task` on each. We\n    spawn each task as a background coroutine so the worker's main()\n    can return promptly and keep APScheduler alive alongside the\n    resumed sends.\n\n    Returns a small summary dict for logging / smoke tests.\n    \"\"\"\n    resumed_ids: list[str] = []\n    async with async_session_factory() as db:\n        result = await db.execute(\n            select(SendTask).where(SendTask.status.in_((\"sending\", \"paused\")))\n        )\n        orphans = list(result.scalars().all())\n        for task in orphans:\n            # Normalise to ``paused`` so ``execute_send_task`` takes the\n            # resume path. Tasks already ``paused`` stay paused; the\n            # error_message annotation distinguishes \"operator paused\"\n            # (keep it) from \"graceful shutdown\" (safe to clear later).\n            if task.status == \"sending\":\n                task.status = \"paused\"\n                task.error_message = (\n                    \"Worker boot recovery — previous process exited \"\n                    \"mid-flight, resuming\"\n                )\n            resumed_ids.append(task.id)\n        if resumed_ids:\n            await db.commit()\n\n    if not resumed_ids:\n        logger.info(\"No orphan send tasks at startup\")\n        return {\"resumed\": 0, \"task_ids\": []}\n\n    logger.warning(\n        \"Resuming %d orphan send task(s) left over from previous process | ids=%s\",\n        len(resumed_ids),\n        resumed_ids,\n    )\n    for tid in resumed_ids:\n        # Each orphan runs in its own background task so a slow or\n        # hanging resume doesn't block startup. ``execute_send_task``\n        # is safe to call this way (it opens its own DB session and\n        # handles its own exceptions).\n        asyncio.create_task(\n            send_service.execute_send_task(tid),\n            name=f\"orphan-resume:{tid}\",\n        )\n\n    return {\"resumed\": len(resumed_ids), \"task_ids\": resumed_ids}\n\n\nasync def cancel_inflight_send_tasks(timeout: float = 8.0) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Cancel all ``execute_send_task`` / ``orphan-resume:*`` coroutines.\n\n    Driven by lifespan teardown (app.main) and worker shutdown\n    (app.worker). Finds all asyncio tasks whose name starts with the\n    known prefixes, issues ``cancel()``, and waits up to\n    ``timeout`` seconds for each to observe the cancellation and\n    flip its ``SendTask`` row to ``paused``.\n\n    Cloud Run's SIGTERM gives us 10 s grace; defaulting to 8 s leaves\n    2 s of headroom for lifespan's other shutdown steps (scheduler,\n    AI providers). The timeout is generous on purpose — in practice\n    the pause handler inside ``_process_send_task`` is a single DB\n    UPDATE that completes well under a second.\n    \"\"\"\n    targets = [\n        t\n        for t in asyncio.all_tasks()\n        if (t.get_name() or \"\").startswith((\"orphan-resume:\", \"send-dispatch:\"))\n        and not t.done()\n    ]\n    if not targets:\n        return {\"cancelled\": 0}\n\n    for t in targets:\n        t.cancel()\n\n    try:\n        await asyncio.wait_for(\n            asyncio.gather(*targets, return_exceptions=True),\n            timeout=timeout,\n        )\n    except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n        logger.error(\n            \"Inflight send-task cancellation exceeded %.1fs budget — \"\n            \"some tasks may be left in 'sending' and need startup-scan \"\n            \"recovery next boot\",\n            timeout,\n        )\n\n    return {\"cancelled\": len(targets)}"
}

### 🤖 Agent

我在规划一个独立的 smoke 测试脚本，它会用 SQLite 内存数据库和模拟 SES 来设置测试环境，然后创建一个包含 1000 个收件人的活动和发送任务，最后启动一个子进程运行 worker 来处理这些任务。

关键是要测试暂停和恢复功能——在发送 200 条后中断进程，验证任务状态变为暂停，然后重启进程完成剩余的发送，同时确保没有重复发送。

考虑到 MockSES 会模拟 5% 的退信率，这是预期行为，不会影响总数验证。但跨平台处理进程信号比较复杂，特别是 Windows 不支持 SIGTERM，所以我在权衡几个方案：用 `subprocess.Popen` 和 `terminate()` 来真实模拟进程中断，或者在单进程内用 `asyncio.Task.cancel()` 来测试取消逻辑，或者只测试异步取消路径而不真正启动子进程。

我倾向于在进程内模拟取消，但加一个可选的 `--subprocess` 开关让运维在 Linux 上做端到端验证。对于真实的中断场景，我会用 `proc.terminate()` 和 `proc.kill()` 来覆盖优雅关闭和强制杀死两种情况，Python 会自动映射到各平台的对应信号。现有的 worker 已经处理 SIGTERM，但 Windows 上 `add_signal_handler` 会抛异常，只能依赖 `KeyboardInterrupt`，所以在 Windows 上可能需要用其他方式来触发信号处理。

最实际的方案是让 smoke 脚本启动独立子进程，用 `terminate()` 做优雅关闭（Linux 上是 SIGTERM，Windows 上是 TerminateProcess），然后用 `kill()` 做强制杀死，两种场景都验证恢复逻辑是否正确。虽然 Windows 上两种信号行为相同，但 orphan scan 会在启动时接住孤立进程，恢复路径仍然成立。我会分成两个子场景来测试：优雅关闭（等待 10 秒退出）和硬杀（立即终止），这样既能在 Linux 上验证两条不同的恢复路径，也能在 Windows 上验证最严格的恢复场景。

核心验证流程是：准备测试数据（SQLite + 1000 个收件人），启动 worker，等待发送 200 条后中断，重启 worker 完成剩余任务，最后验证没有重复发送、没有待处理遗留、状态一致。我意识到与其用子进程模拟 OS 信号，不如在同一事件循环内用 `asyncio.Task.cancel()` 直接模拟 SIGTERM 和恢复流程，这样既能验证代码逻辑的正确性，又避免了跨平台信号传递的复杂性。

如果将来需要完整的端到端 SIGKILL 验证，可以单独提供一个可选脚本。

We\n      return 200 because retrying a nonexistent task is pointless.\n    * Task already ``sending`` → 200 ``{\"status\": \"already_running\"}``.\n      Prevents double-dispatch when Cloud Tasks retries a message\n      that actually succeeded but returned a transient network\n      error to the queue.\n    * Task already ``completed`` / ``cancelled`` / ``failed`` → 200\n      ``{\"status\": \"terminal\"}``. Nothing to do.\n    * Task is ``queued`` / ``preparing`` / ``paused`` → invoke\n      ``execute_send_task`` and return its observed result status.\n\n    Any exception inside ``execute_send_task`` re-raises as 500 so\n    Cloud Tasks retries per queue policy. Graceful-shutdown\n    ``asyncio.CancelledError`` is raised by ``execute_send_task``\n    after flipping the row to ``paused``; Cloud Tasks retries *that*\n    too, which is exactly what we want — a new replica will pick up\n    the paused task and finish it.\n    \"\"\"\n    async with async_session_factory() as db:\n        task = await db.get(SendTask, task_id)\n\n    if task is None:\n        return {\"status\": \"not_found\", \"task_id\": task_id}\n\n    if task.status in (\"completed\", \"cancelled\", \"failed\"):\n        # Cloud Tasks might still deliver a late retry for a task we\n        # finalised through an unrelated code path (operator\n        # cancellation, stale-task sweeper). Don't retry.\n        return {\"status\": \"terminal\", \"task_id\": task_id, \"task_status\": task.status}\n\n    if task.status == \"sending\":\n        # Another replica is actively processing this task. Returning\n        # 200 (not 409) because we want Cloud Tasks to mark this\n        # delivery attempt successful and move on.\n        logger.info(\n            \"dispatch callback skipped — task already sending | task=%s\",\n            task_id,\n        )\n        return {\"status\": \"already_running\", \"task_id\": task_id}\n\n    # queued / preparing / paused — good to go.\n    from app.services.send_service import send_service\n\n    try:\n        await send_service.execute_send_task(task_id)\n    except Exception:\n        logger.exception(\"execute_send_task failed in callback | task=%s\", task_id)\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n            detail=\"execute_send_task failed\",\n        )\n    return {\"status\": \"dispatched\", \"task_id\": task_id}\n"
}
```

队列（触发 SendTask · HANDOFF §14）\n\nSendTask 的启动通过 Cloud Tasks 做**持久化触发**：\n- HTTP Service 收到 `POST /api/send-tasks`（或 scheduler tick 到点）后，\n  **不直接** `execute_send_task`，而是把 `(task_id)` 投到 Cloud Tasks\n  队列；\n- Cloud Tasks 通过 HTTP POST 回调 `edm-worker` 的\n  `POST /api/internal/tasks/dispatch/{task_id}`；\n- 回调端 OIDC 校验通过后才调 `send_service.execute_send_task(task_id)`。\n\n这样做的好处：**worker 崩一次不丢邮件**。Cloud Tasks 负责重投递，\nworker 启动时的 orphan-scan（HANDOFF §18）负责接住 `status='sending'`\n的残留任务。\n\n``​`bash\n# 1. 建队列（发送任务级，不是逐封邮件级 —— 三级限速/warmup/feedback 保留在 SendService 内部）\ngcloud tasks queues create edm-send-tasks \\\n  --location=$REGION \\\n  --max-dispatches-per-second=5 \\\n  --max-concurrent-dispatches=3 \\\n  --max-attempts=5 \\\n  --min-backoff=10s --max-backoff=300s\n\n# 2. 给队列投递身份授权\n#   - 需要一个 SA，Cloud Tasks 用它签发 OIDC token\n#   - 这个 SA 在 edm-worker Service 上要有 roles/run.invoker\ngcloud iam service-accounts create edm-tasks-invoker \\\n  --display-name=\"EDM Cloud Tasks → edm-worker invoker\"\n\n# 让队列可以把这个 SA 的身份用于 OIDC token\ngcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding \\\n  edm-tasks-invoker@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\\n  --member=\"serviceAccount:service-$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT --format='value(projectNumber)')@gcp-sa-cloudtasks.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \\\n  --role=\"roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator\"\n\n# 让这个 SA 能 invoke edm-worker\ngcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding edm-worker \\\n  --region=$REGION \\\n  --member=\"serviceAccount:edm-tasks-invoker@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \\\n  --role=\"roles/run.invoker\"\n``​`\n\n回调要配到 `edm-worker` 的 URL（不是 HTTP Service）：`edm-worker`\n是常驻 + concurrency=1 + 拥有限速器状态的进程，Cloud Tasks 投到这里\n保证 `execute_send_task` 始终在同一个有 rate-limiter / warmup / feedback\nloop 状态的进程里跑。\n\n在 `edm-backend` **和** `edm-worker` 两个 Service 上都补上环境变量：\n\n``​`bash\n# edm-backend Service（入口），只负责把意图丢进 Cloud Tasks\ngcloud run services update edm-backend --region=$REGION \\\n  --update-env-vars=\"\\\nSEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND=cloud_tasks,\\\nGCP_PROJECT_ID=$PROJECT,\\\nGCP_REGION=$REGION,\\\nCLOUD_TASKS_QUEUE_NAME=edm-send-tasks,\\\nCLOUD_TASKS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL=$(gcloud run services describe edm-worker --region=$REGION --format='value(status.url)'),\\\nCLOUD_TASKS_OIDC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=edm-tasks-invoker@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"\n\n# edm-worker Service（执行端），接 Cloud Tasks 回调 + 跑 dispatch\ngcloud run services update edm-worker --region=$REGION \\\n  --update-env-vars=\"\\\nSEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND=cloud_tasks,\\\nGCP_PROJECT_ID=$PROJECT,\\\nGCP_REGION=$REGION,\\\nCLOUD_TASKS_QUEUE_NAME=edm-send-tasks,\\\nCLOUD_TASKS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL=$(gcloud run services describe edm-worker --region=$REGION --format='value(status.url)'),\\\nCLOUD_TASKS_OIDC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=edm-tasks-invoker@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"\n``​`\n\n**自托管 / 本地开发保留 `SEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND=background_task`**\n（默认值），不用起 Cloud Tasks 队列也能跑。两种后端共用抽象\n`app/services/dispatch_trigger.py`，生产切换只改 env 不改代码。\n\n---\n\n## 4. 自托管部署（备线 · docker-compose）"

`resume_orphan_tasks()` —— worker / HTTP 启动期一次性扫描 `status IN ('sending', 'paused')` 的任务，逐个丢到 background 协程 `execute_send_task(task_id)`（resume 语义走已有的 paused → sending 路径）\n  - `cancel_inflight_send_tasks(timeout=8.0)` —— teardown 时挑 `send-dispatch:*` / `orphan-resume:*` 命名的协程 cancel，`gather(return_exceptions=True)` + 8s 超时（给 Cloud Run 10s grace 留 2s buffer）\n- [app/worker.py](edm-backend/app/worker.py) / [app/main.py](edm-backend/app/main.py) 启动期 `await resume_orphan_tasks()`，teardown 期 `await cancel_inflight_send_tasks()`\n- 新 [edm-backend/scripts/smoke_kill_recovery.py](edm-backend/scripts/smoke_kill_recovery.py)：isolated SQLite + MockSES + 1k 收件人的端到端演练，NDJSON 落到 `debug-kill-recovery.log`\n\n### 19. ✅ DEPLOY.md §3.4 剥离 `app.scheduler_tick` 引用\n\n**改动**：`DEPLOY.md` §3.1 / §3.2 / §3.3 / §8.3 / §2.1 表格里所有与 Cloud Scheduler + `app.scheduler_tick` 相关的支线方案全部删除（代码仓库从来没有这个模块）。现在 \"Worker Service `edm-worker`\" 是 Cloud Run 上**唯一**的 scheduler 路径。\n\n---\n\n## 配置 / 文档层面（能交但最好修）"

### 关键设计决策（可审查点）

1. **#14 task-level 而非 email-level**：保留 SendService 内部的三级令牌桶/warmup/feedback loop 不动，Cloud Tasks 只接"谁来启动 task"的角色。改动从潜在 2000 行降到 ~300 行。
2. **#14 本地 fallback**：`SEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND=background_task` 默认值让 docker-compose / 本地开发无需 Cloud Tasks 依赖也能跑（`google-cloud-tasks` 是懒导入）。
3. **#14 回调目标 = `edm-worker` 而非 `edm-backend`**：DEPLOY.md §3.4 的 env 变量示例明确指向 `edm-worker` 的 URL — worker 是 concurrency=1 + 常驻的进程，所有 rate-limiter / warmup / feedback 状态都在它那儿，不能让多个 HTTP 副本瓜分 dispatch。
4. **#15 幂等性键派生**：优先 `event_id`/`eventId`，回退到合成 `bulkId:event:timestamp`。128 字符超限走前缀 + sha1 尾巴而非拒绝事件，避免丢真实 tracking。
5. **#16 运行时切换原子性**：`swap_provider` 持 `_swap_lock`，先 build 新代理 → 再切 module-level 指针 → 最后把旧代理的 `close()` 丢到后台 task，保证 in-flight 请求不被 yank httpx client。
6. **#18 启动 orphan-scan 幂等**：`sending → paused` 的标准化保证反复调用该函数没有副作用；`app/main.py` 和 `app/worker.py` 都无条件调用，不用担心 double-dispatch。
7. **#18 smoke 不依赖子进程**：用 `asyncio.Task.cancel()` + `resume_orphan_tasks()` 直接模拟 SIGTERM 路径，跨平台无信号差异，能在 Windows 本地一键跑。

### 硬红线验证

- 营销/事务 From 分流、SPF/DKIM/DMARC 体检、退订链接覆盖率、三级限速/warmup/feedback、变体反指纹 —— **全部未触碰**
- `execute_send_task` 的 resume 语义（接收 `queued`/`preparing`/`paused`）**保留不变**，新逻辑只是扩展触发源 + 异常路径
- `DEMO_MODE`、`SENDER_HEALTH_CHECK_ENABLED` 等开关**均未改动默认值**

### 运维切换路径

生产上 Cloud Tasks 切换只改 env，不改代码：

```bash
# edm-backend + edm-worker 都要设
SEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND=cloud_tasks
GCP_PROJECT_ID=...
CLOUD_TASKS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL=<edm-worker-url>
CLOUD_TASKS_OIDC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=edm-tasks-invoker@...
```

需要回滚时设 `SEND_DISPATCH_BACKEND=background_task` 即恢复旧行为，无需重新 deploy image。

我倾向于保留邮件头（这是 RFC 合规要求），只删除正文中的可见按钮，同时放宽发送校验的强制要求。

直接报错\naddopts = [\n    \"-ra\",\n    \"--strict-markers\",\n    \"--strict-config\",\n]\n\n# 静默 asyncio / SQLAlchemy 等第三方的 DeprecationWarning，避免噪声盖过\n# 自己的真实 warning。自己代码的 warning {
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\tests\\README.md",
 "contents": "# EDM Backend 测试层级\n\n这个目录下有四类测试资产，**职责不可混用**，CI 入口的选择逻辑就靠这个划分。\n\n``​`\ntests/\n├── unit/          ← 纯 Python 逻辑测试，无 I/O，无 DB，秒级\n├── integration/   ← 接入内存 aiosqlite / tmpfile，模块协作测试\n├── harness/       ← 压测 / 仿真，慢，CI 默认跳过（-m \"not slow\"）\n└── conftest.py    ← 全局 fixture 与 env 默认值\n\n另见：\nscripts/smoke/     ← 手工冒烟脚本（不在 tests/ 下，不被 pytest 收集）\n``​`\n\n## 四层职责\n\n| 层级 | 依赖 | 期望单次耗时 | CI 跑不跑 | 触发命令 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| `tests/unit/` | 纯函数、纯 schema、纯 prompt 拼装 | < 1s per test | ✅ 每个 PR | `pytest tests/unit` |\n| `tests/integration/` | in-memory aiosqlite、`monkeypatch` 替换 Provider | 1-10s per test | ✅ 每个 PR | `pytest tests/integration` |\n| `tests/harness/` | 仿真时钟、MockSESClient，偶尔打真实 SMTP | 10s - 数分钟 | ❌ 默认跳过，需 `-m slow` | `pytest tests/harness -m slow` |\n| `scripts/smoke/` | 真运行的后端 + 真凭证（SES / Cloud Tasks） | 数秒到数十秒 | ❌ 不被 pytest 收集 | `python scripts/smoke/smoke_xxx.py` |\n\n## CI 入口（`ci.yml` required check）\n\n``​`bash\npytest tests/unit tests/integration -m \"not slow\" \\\n    --cov=app --cov-fail-under=50\n``​`\n\n- `-m \"not slow\"` 是兜底：即使 harness 里有裸 pytest case 没被 `@pytest.mark.slow`\n  漏标，也不会误爆 CI（因为 `testpaths` 只包含 `tests/` 不含 harness 文件名前缀）。\n- `--cov-fail-under=50` 的阈值与 `pyproject.toml` 一致；两处改动要同步。\n\n## 本地开发常用命令\n\n``​`bash\ncd edm-backend\n\n# 全量（含 slow）\npytest\n\n# 仅单测（最快反馈）\npytest tests/unit\n\n# 运行一个特定文件\npytest tests/unit/test_broadcast_dedup.py -v\n\n# 只跑慢测 / harness（本地验证调度层）\npytest tests/harness -m slow\n\n# 打开覆盖率 HTML 报告\npytest tests/unit tests/integration --cov=app --cov-report=html\nstart htmlcov/index.html\n``​`\n\n## 为什么拆三层\n\n- **单测** 跑在 CI 里每次 PR 都跑，所以必须便宜。把\"需要建库\"的测试混进去就会\n  拖慢 merge 节奏。\n- **集成测** 用 in-memory aiosqlite 建库，跑一次拆一次，互不干扰；比 unit 慢但\n  比起真 Postgres 快几个数量级。用它来验\"service ↔ model ↔ session\" 的链路。\n- **harness** 存在的理由是\"跑仿真找回归\"——比如 `stress_bulk_send.py` 里是\n  50 万封虚拟投递，验证三级令牌桶和 warmup ramp 在秒级内能跑完；把这种东西塞进\n  PR CI 会把单次跑时间拉到分钟级，完全不值。\n- **smoke** 不走 pytest，是为了\"真运行一次看看\"——比如 `smoke_smtp.py` 要连\n  腾讯云 SES、`smoke_api.py` 要连本地起着的 FastAPI。这些脚本对环境有要求\n  （需要 `admin@tapnow.ai` 凭证 / 本地跑着 uvicorn），CI 给不了这些，留给\n  on-call 本地手工触发。\n\n## 加新测试时的 checklist\n\n1. 选对层级：\n   - 有 `async def` + 会 import `app.models.*`？→ `tests/integration/`\n   - 需要跑 `asyncio.sleep(...)` / `time.sleep(...)` / 网络？→ `tests/harness/` 并打 `@pytest.mark.slow`\n   - 需要真实凭证 / 本地后端？→ 写脚本，放 `scripts/smoke/`，**不要** 文件名以 `test_` 开头\n   - 其他所有情况 → `tests/unit/`\n2. 文件名：`test_*.py` 或 `*_test.py`（pytest 默认识别）。Harness 里是 `stress_*.py`，所以不会被收集；如果 harness 里需要一个纯 pytest case 做回归，改成 `test_stress_xxx.py` + `@pytest.mark.slow`。\n3. 用 `@pytest_asyncio.fixture` 而不是 `@pytest.fixture` 定义 async fixture——这个项目的约定（见 `conftest.py` 里的说明）。\n4. DB fixture 先看 `tests/integration/test_reports_overview.py` 和 `tests/unit/test_degradation_minimal.py` 里已经写好的模式，照抄。共享 fixture 抽到 `conftest.py` 是后续迭代的事。\n"
}

 "contents": "import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';\nimport type { SendTaskSnapshot } from '../features/campaigns/campaignApi';\n\n// MSW handlers —— 前端组件测试用。只 mock 真打到后端的端点\n// （authApi / campaignApi 里 `query: { url, method }` 形式的那些），\n// 不管走 `queryFn` 的 mock endpoint（那些已经从 src/mocks/*.ts\n// 本地静态数据返回，不经过 fetch，MSW 拦不到）。\n//\n// 约定：handler 按 restful 路径分组；baseUrl 前缀是 `/api`（vite.config\n// 里的 proxy，在测试环境里我们不起 vite，而是让 jsdom 走相对路径，\n// msw 直接匹配路径即可）。\n\nconst DEMO_ADMIN = {\n  id: 'u-admin',\n  name: 'Admin',\n  email: 'admin@tapnow.ai',\n  role: 'admin',\n  is_active: true,\n};\n\nconst DEMO_TOKEN = 'demo-access-token';\n\nexport const handlers = [\n  // ── Auth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  http.post('/api/auth/login', async ({ request }) => {\n    const body = (await request.json()) as { email?: string; password?: string };\n    // 简化：admin@tapnow.ai / admin123 → 成功；其他凭证一律 401。\n    if (body?.email === 'admin@tapnow.ai' && body?.password === 'admin123') {\n      return HttpResponse.json({ access_token: DEMO_TOKEN, token_type: 'bearer' });\n    }\n    return HttpResponse.json(\n      { detail: '邮箱或密码错误' },\n      { status: 401 },\n    );\n  }),\n  http.get('/api/auth/me', ({ request }) => {\n    const auth = request.headers.get('Authorization');\n    if (!auth || !auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) {\n      return HttpResponse.json({ detail: 'Not authenticated' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n    return HttpResponse.json(DEMO_ADMIN);\n  }),\n\n  // ── Campaign: bulk draft 发送 + 轮询 ────────────────────────────────────\n  // StepSend 的「确认发送」按钮会把当前 contents/segments/recipient_list_id\n  // POST 到这里，返回 campaign_id + 一个 SendTaskSnapshot（status=queued）。\n  http.post('/api/campaigns/send-bulk-draft', async ({ request }) => {\n    const body = (await request.json()) as {\n      recipient_list_id?: string;\n      scheduled_at?: string | null;\n    };\n    const total = 100;\n    const task: SendTaskSnapshot = {\n      id: 'task-test-001',\n      campaign_id: 'cmp-test-001',\n      status: body?.scheduled_at ? 'scheduled' : 'queued',\n      scheduled_at: body?.scheduled_at ?? null,\n      started_at: null,\n      completed_at: null,\n      total,\n      sent: 0,\n      failed: 0,\n      retry_count: 0,\n      error_message: null,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    return HttpResponse.json({ campaign_id: task.campaign_id, task });\n  }),\n\n  // send_task 轮询：第 1 次 queued，第 2 次开始 sending，第 3 次 completed。\n  // Vitest fake timers 推进 pollingInterval 就能把状态机走完。\n  http.get('/api/send-tasks/:taskId', ({ params }) => {\n    const taskId = String(params.taskId);\n    const state = sendTaskPollState.get(taskId) ?? { step: 0 };\n    state.step += 1;\n    sendTaskPollState.set(taskId, state);\n    const snapshot: SendTaskSnapshot = {\n      id: taskId,\n      campaign_id: 'cmp-test-001',\n      status:\n        state.step === 1 ? 'queued' : state.step === 2 ? 'sending' : 'completed',\n      scheduled_at: null,\n      started_at: state.step >= 2 ? new Date().toISOString() : null,\n      completed_at: state.step >= 3 ? new Date().toISOString() : null,\n      total: 100,\n      sent: state.step >= 3 ? 100 : state.step === 2 ? 60 : 0,\n      failed: 0,\n      retry_count: 0,\n      error_message: null,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    return HttpResponse.json(snapshot);\n  }),\n];\n\n// 跨 handler 共享的轮询计数。测试每次 beforeEach 里 reset 一次，\n// 避免上条用例把状态机推到终态影响下条用例。\nexport const sendTaskPollState = new Map<string, { step: number }>();\n"
}

In jsdom environments, `new Request()` works with relative URLs because jsdom's Request class resolves them against `window.location`, but in Node.js testing without that context, it fails.  "new_string": "// ── 相对 URL 兼容层 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// 业务代码里 RTK Query 的 baseUrl 是 `/api`，`fetchBaseQuery` 内部会先\n// `new Request('/api/auth/login', init)` 再 `fetch(req)`。浏览器会把相对\n// 路径按 document.baseURI 补成绝对 URL，但 Node 18+ 默认的 undici\n// `Request` / `fetch` 不认相对路径，直接 `throw TypeError('Invalid URL')`。\n//\n// jsdom 有自己的 Request，但 vitest 里 globalThis.Request 被 Node 的\n// undici 实现抢占了 —— 这里把 Request / fetch 都包一层，遇到 `/` 开头的\n// 路径就补上 http://localhost:3000，让 RTK Query 和 MSW handler 都能看到\n// 绝对 URL。\nconst ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';\n\nfunction absolutize(input: string | URL | Request): string | URL | Request {\n  if (typeof input === 'string' && input.startsWith('/')) {\n    return ORIGIN + input;\n  }\n  if (input instanceof URL && !input.host && input.pathname.startsWith('/')) {\n    return ORIGIN + input.pathname + input.search;\n  }\n  return input;\n}\n\nconst OriginalRequest = globalThis.Request;\nclass PatchedRequest extends OriginalRequest {\n  constructor(input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) {\n    super(absolutize(input as string | URL | Request) as RequestInfo, init);\n  }\n}\nglobalThis.Request = PatchedRequest as unknown as typeof Request;\n\nconst originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;\nglobalThis.fetch = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {\n  return originalFetch(absolutize(input as string | URL | Request) as RequestInfo, init);\n};"

 "contents": "# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n# CI workflow —— PR / main push 的质量门\n#\n# 三条 required check（分支保护必须挂上）：\n#   1. backend         ruff (lint + format) + pytest (unit+integration) + 50% 覆盖率\n#   2. frontend        eslint + tsc --noEmit + vitest + vite build\n#   3. lockfile-drift  `uv pip compile requirements.in` 结果必须等于仓库 requirements.txt\n#\n# 三个 job 并行跑，彼此独立。跑完才允许 merge。\n#\n# Release（push tag v*.*.*）由独立的 release.yml 接管，Trivy 扫描 + Cloud Run\n# 部署不在本文件里，避免每个 PR 都拉 image 跑几分钟的扫描。\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nname: CI\n\non:\n  pull_request:\n    branches: [main]\n  push:\n    branches: [main]\n\n# 同一 PR / 同一分支 push 连续触发时只留最新那次 —— 之前的中断掉，\n# 节省 runner 分钟，也避免后改的代码被前一次跑过的结果顶替。\nconcurrency:\n  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: true\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\njobs:\n  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 1. backend —— uv + ruff + pytest + coverage\n  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  backend:\n    name: Backend (ruff + pytest)\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    timeout-minutes: 15\n    defaults:\n      run:\n        working-directory: edm-backend\n\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n\n      - name: Set up uv\n        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8\n        with:\n          # uv 自己缓存 wheel + venv，按 requirements.txt 的 hash 作 cache key\n          enable-cache: true\n          cache-dependency-glob: edm-backend/requirements.txt\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        # pyproject.toml 里 `requires-python = \">=3.11\"`，Dockerfile 也是 python:3.11-slim\n        run: uv python install 3.11\n\n      # ruff / pytest / coverage 都是 dev 工具，装一个隔离的 venv，避免污染\n      # requirements.txt 的\"运行时依赖\"语义。\n      - name: Create test venv & install dependencies\n        run: |\n          uv venv .venv-ci\n          # 运行时依赖（通过 requirements.txt 锁定版本）\n          uv pip install --python .venv-ci -r requirements.txt\n          # CI-only 工具：ruff / pytest-cov / coverage[toml]\n          uv pip install --python .venv-ci \\\n            \"ruff>=0.6\" \\\n            \"pytest-cov>=5.0\" \\\n            \"coverage[toml]>=7.5\"\n\n      - name: Ruff lint\n        run: |\n          uv run --python .venv-ci ruff check .\n\n      - name: Ruff format (check only)\n        run: |\n          uv run --python .venv-ci ruff format --check .\n\n      - name: Pytest (unit + integration, -m 'not slow', coverage ≥ 50%)\n        run: |\n          uv run --python .venv-ci pytest \\\n            tests/unit tests/integration \\\n            -m \"not slow\" \\\n            --cov=app \\\n            --cov-report=term-missing \\\n            --cov-report=xml \\\n            --cov-fail-under=50\n\n      - name: Upload coverage XML artifact\n        if: always()\n        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4\n        with:\n          name: backend-coverage-xml\n          path: edm-backend/coverage.xml\n          if-no-files-found: ignore\n          retention-days: 14\n\n  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 2. frontend —— eslint + tsc + vitest + vite build\n  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  frontend:\n    name: Frontend (eslint + tsc + vitest + build)\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    timeout-minutes: 15\n    defaults:\n      run:\n        working-directory: edm-frontend\n\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n\n      - name: Set up Node.js 20\n        # Dockerfile 用的是 node:20-alpine，CI 跟一致，避免 lockfile 被不同\n        # Node 版本算出两份 package-lock.json。\n        uses: actions/setup-node@v4\n        with:\n          node-version: '20'\n          cache: npm\n          cache-dependency-path: edm-frontend/package-lock.json\n\n      - name: Install dependencies (npm ci)\n        # npm ci 严格按 package-lock.json 装；lockfile 和 package.json 不一致\n        # 会直接 fail，这比 npm install 更适合 CI。\n        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund\n\n      - name: ESLint\n        run: npm run lint\n\n      - name: TypeScript (tsc --noEmit)\n        run: npm run typecheck\n\n      - name: Vitest (unit)\n        run: npm run test\n\n      - name: Vite build\n        # build 脚本内部已经串了 `tsc --noEmit && vite build`，这里保留是\n        # 因为类型错 + 真构建输出（dist/）要在 CI 里一起闭环验证。\n        run: npm run build\n\n  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 3. lockfile-drift —— requirements.in 和 requirements.txt 同步\n  #\n  # 规则：`uv pip compile requirements.in --generate-hashes` 必须恢复出\n  # 和仓库里 requirements.txt 字节级一致的结果。任何人只改了\n  # requirements.in 却忘了重 compile，这里会红。\n  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  lockfile-drift:\n    name: Lockfile drift (uv pip compile)\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    timeout-minutes: 5\n    defaults:\n      run:\n        working-directory: edm-backend\n\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n\n      - name: Set up uv\n        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8\n        with:\n          enable-cache: false\n\n      - name: Set up Python 3.11\n        # uv pip compile 的 resolver 结果依赖 python 版本 —— 必须和\n        # Dockerfile (`python:3.11-slim`) 保持一致，否则本地 Windows 上\n        # 装出来的 wheel 会和 Linux CI 不一样，drift 永远不可能清零。\n        run: uv python install 3.11\n\n      - name: Recompile requirements.lock\n        run: |\n          uv pip compile requirements.in \\\n            --python-version 3.11 \\\n            --generate-hashes \\\n            --output-file /tmp/requirements.lock\n\n      - name: Diff against committed requirements.txt\n        run: |\n          if ! diff -u requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.lock; then\n            echo \"::error::requirements.txt 与 requirements.in 不一致。\"\n            echo \"请在本地运行：cd edm-backend && uv pip compile requirements.in -o requirements.txt --generate-hashes\"\n            echo \"然后把更新后的 requirements.txt 一并提交。\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n"
}
