'v*.*.*'\n\n# 同一 tag 串行，避免重复推镜像 / deploy race\nconcurrency:\n  group: release-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n  id-token: write        # WIF: 换 OIDC token\n  security-events: write # Trivy SARIF 上传 Code Scanning\n\njobs:\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 1. 构建并推送两份镜像\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  build-push:\n    name: Build & Push Images\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    environment: production\n    outputs:\n      tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}\n      image-backend: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image-backend }}\n      image-frontend: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image-frontend }}\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n\n      - name: Resolve image tags\n        id: meta\n        env:\n          AR_REGISTRY: ${{ vars.AR_REGISTRY }}\n          AR_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.AR_REPOSITORY }}\n          GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          TAG=\"${GITHUB_REF_NAME}\"\n          BASE=\"${AR_REGISTRY}/${GCP_PROJECT_ID}/${AR_REPOSITORY}\"\n          {\n            echo \"tag=${TAG}\"\n            echo \"image-backend=${BASE}/edm-backend:${TAG}\"\n            echo \"image-frontend=${BASE}/edm-frontend:${TAG}\"\n          } >> \"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}\"\n\n      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud (WIF)\n        id: auth\n        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2\n        with:\n          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}\n          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}\n          token_format: access_token\n\n      - name: Log in to Artifact Registry\n        uses: docker/login-action@v3\n        with:\n          registry: ${{ vars.AR_REGISTRY }}\n          username: oauth2accesstoken\n          password: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.access_token }}\n\n      - name: Set up Docker Buildx\n        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3\n\n      - name: Build & push edm-backend\n        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6\n        with:\n          context: ./edm-backend\n          file: ./edm-backend/Dockerfile\n          push: true\n          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image-backend }}\n          cache-from: type=gha,scope=edm-backend\n          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=edm-backend\n          provenance: false\n\n      - name: Build & push edm-frontend\n        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6\n        with:\n          context: ./edm-frontend\n          file: ./edm-frontend/Dockerfile\n          push: true\n          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image-frontend }}\n          build-args: |\n            VITE_APP_VERSION=${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}\n          cache-from: type=gha,scope=edm-frontend\n          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=edm-frontend\n          provenance: false\n\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 2. 安全扫描：HIGH 只上报，CRITICAL 阻塞\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  scan-backend:\n    name: Trivy Scan (edm-backend)\n    needs: build-push\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    environment: production\n    steps:\n      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud (WIF)\n        id: auth\n        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2\n        with:\n          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}\n          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}\n          token_format: access_token\n\n      - name: Log in to Artifact Registry\n        uses: docker/login-action@v3\n        with:\n          registry: ${{ vars.AR_REGISTRY }}\n          username: oauth2accesstoken\n          password: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.access_token }}\n\n      - name: Trivy scan (HIGH, soft gate)\n        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0\n        with:\n          image-ref: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-backend }}\n          format: sarif\n          output: trivy-backend-high.sarif\n          severity: HIGH\n          ignore-unfixed: true\n          exit-code: '0'\n          vuln-type: os,library\n\n      - name: Upload HIGH SARIF\n        if: always()\n        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3\n        with:\n          sarif_file: trivy-backend-high.sarif\n          category: trivy-backend-high\n\n      - name: Trivy scan (CRITICAL, hard gate)\n        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0\n        with:\n          image-ref: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-backend }}\n          format: sarif\n          output: trivy-backend-critical.sarif\n          severity: CRITICAL\n          ignore-unfixed: true\n          exit-code: '1'\n          vuln-type: os,library\n\n      - name: Upload CRITICAL SARIF\n        if: always()\n        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3\n        with:\n          sarif_file: trivy-backend-critical.sarif\n          category: trivy-backend-critical\n\n  scan-frontend:\n    name: Trivy Scan (edm-frontend)\n    needs: build-push\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    environment: production\n    steps:\n      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud (WIF)\n        id: auth\n        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2\n        with:\n          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}\n          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}\n          token_format: access_token\n\n      - name: Log in to Artifact Registry\n        uses: docker/login-action@v3\n        with:\n          registry: ${{ vars.AR_REGISTRY }}\n          username: oauth2accesstoken\n          password: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.access_token }}\n\n      - name: Trivy scan (HIGH, soft gate)\n        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0\n        with:\n          image-ref: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-frontend }}\n          format: sarif\n          output: trivy-frontend-high.sarif\n          severity: HIGH\n          ignore-unfixed: true\n          exit-code: '0'\n          vuln-type: os,library\n\n      - name: Upload HIGH SARIF\n        if: always()\n        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3\n        with:\n          sarif_file: trivy-frontend-high.sarif\n          category: trivy-frontend-high\n\n      - name: Trivy scan (CRITICAL, hard gate)\n        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0\n        with:\n          image-ref: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-frontend }}\n          format: sarif\n          output: trivy-frontend-critical.sarif\n          severity: CRITICAL\n          ignore-unfixed: true\n          exit-code: '1'\n          vuln-type: os,library\n\n      - name: Upload CRITICAL SARIF\n        if: always()\n        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3\n        with:\n          sarif_file: trivy-frontend-critical.sarif\n          category: trivy-frontend-critical\n\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 3. Cloud Run 三个 Service 部署\n  #    env_vars / secrets 假定首次上线已经按 DEPLOY.md §2.3-§2.4 配好；\n  #    这里只滚动更新镜像，不动配置，避免 workflow 里泄露敏感默认值。\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  deploy-backend:\n    name: Deploy edm-backend (Cloud Run)\n    needs: [build-push, scan-backend]\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    environment: production\n    steps:\n      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud (WIF)\n        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2\n        with:\n          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}\n          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}\n\n      - name: Deploy edm-backend\n        uses: google-github-actions/deploy-cloudrun@v2\n        with:\n          service: edm-backend\n          region: ${{ vars.GCP_REGION }}\n          image: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-backend }}\n\n  deploy-worker:\n    name: Deploy edm-worker (Cloud Run · reuses backend image)\n    needs: [build-push, scan-backend]\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    environment: production\n    steps:\n      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud (WIF)\n        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2\n        with:\n          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}\n          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}\n\n      - name: Deploy edm-worker\n        uses: google-github-actions/deploy-cloudrun@v2\n        with:\n          service: edm-worker\n          region: ${{ vars.GCP_REGION }}\n          image: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-backend }}\n\n  deploy-frontend:\n    name: Deploy edm-frontend (Cloud Run)\n    needs: [build-push, scan-frontend]\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    environment: production\n    steps:\n      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud (WIF)\n        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2\n        with:\n          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}\n          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}\n\n      - name: Deploy edm-frontend\n        uses: google-github-actions/deploy-cloudrun@v2\n        with:\n          service: edm-frontend\n          region: ${{ vars.GCP_REGION }}\n          image: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.image-frontend }}\n\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  # 4. 汇总：所有 deploy 绿才算整体 release 成功\n  # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  release-summary:\n    name: Release Summary\n    needs: [build-push, deploy-backend, deploy-worker, deploy-frontend]\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    if: always()\n    steps:\n      - name: Summarize\n        env:\n          TAG: ${{ needs.build-push.outputs.tag }}\n          R_BE: ${{ needs.deploy-backend.result }}\n          R_WK: ${{ needs.deploy-worker.result }}\n          R_FE: ${{ needs.deploy-frontend.result }}\n        run: |\n          {\n            echo \"## Release ${TAG} — Cloud Run rollout summary\"\n            echo \"\"\n            echo \"| Service | Result |\"\n            echo \"|---|---|\"\n            echo \"| edm-backend  | ${R_BE} |\"\n            echo \"| edm-worker   | ${R_WK} |\"\n            echo \"| edm-frontend | ${R_FE} |\"\n          } >> \"${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}\"\n\n          if [ \"${R_BE}\" != \"success\" ] || [ \"${R_WK}\" != \"success\" ] || [ \"${R_FE}\" != \"success\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::one or more deploy jobs failed (be=${R_BE} wk=${R_WK} fe=${R_FE})\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n"
}

`SENTRY_DSN: str = \"\"`\n  - `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT: str = \"\"`（留空自动推导：`DEBUG=True→\"dev\"` 否则 `\"prod\"`）\n  - `SENTRY_RELEASE: str = \"\"`（CI 传 git sha 进来）\n  - `SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE: float = 0.1`\n  - `SENTRY_PROFILES_SAMPLE_RATE: float = 0.0`\n  - `LOG_JSON: bool = False`\n  - `READYZ_CHECK_AI: bool = False`\n  - `READYZ_DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: float = 2.0`\n\n### P1.2 新文件\n\n- `edm-backend/app/core/request_context.py`：暴露 `request_id_var: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar(\"request_id\", default=\"-\")`，提供 `set_request_id()` / `get_request_id()`。\n- `edm-backend/app/core/sentry_init.py`：封装 `init_sentry()`；DSN 空直接 `return`；集成 `FastApiIntegration / StarletteIntegration / SqlalchemyIntegration / LoggingIntegration`（`event_level=ERROR`，把 `logger.exception` 自动抓成 event）；`send_default_pii=False`（收件邮箱是 PII）。\n- `edm-backend/app/core/middleware.py`：`RequestContextMiddleware`，从 `X-Request-ID` header 读入（缺失生成 `uuid4`），塞进 contextvar + `sentry_sdk.set_tag(\"request_id\", ...)`，响应头回写 `X-Request-ID` 方便前端/运维串联。\n\n### P1.3 改造 [`edm-backend/app/core/logging_config.py`](edm-backend/app/core/logging_config.py)\n\n- 新增 `RequestIdFilter`：每条 log 记录自动挂 `record.request_id = request_id_var.get()`。\n- 根据 `settings.LOG_JSON` 选 formatter：\n  - JSON mode：`pythonjsonlogger.jsonlogger.JsonFormatter`，输出字段 `timestamp, severity, logger, message, request_id, module, lineno, exc_info`。`severity` 用 `record.levelname` 原名，GCP Cloud Logging 的 fluentd 会直接识别这个字段做分级染色。\n  - 文本 mode：保留 `LOG_FORMAT` 现有格式，format 末尾加 `| req=%(request_id)s` 方便本地肉眼 grep。\n- 保留 `sqlalchemy.engine / apscheduler / httpx` 的现有 level 覆盖。\n\n### P1.4 改 [`edm-backend/app/main.py`](edm-backend/app/main.py)\n\n关键插入点（按顺序）：\n\n``​`python\nsetup_logging()\nfrom app.core.sentry_init import init_sentry\ninit_sentry()\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"app\")\n...\napp = FastAPI(...)\nfrom app.core.middleware import RequestContextMiddleware\napp.add_middleware(RequestContextMiddleware)   # 必须在 CORSMiddleware 之前\napp.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, ...)\n``​`\n\n健康检查改造（当前第 274-287 行那个 `/health`）：\n\n- 保留 `/health` 作为兼容别名，内部调用 `/livez` 逻辑。\n- 新增 `/livez`：进程活着即 200，不查任何下游。\n- 新增 `/readyz`：\n  - `SELECT 1` 对 `async_session_factory()`，用 `asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=READYZ_DB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)` 包一层。\n  - `READYZ_CHECK_AI=true` 时对主 provider 做一次 1s HEAD/OPTIONS（通过现有 `httpx.AsyncClient`），避免 DB/AI 双挂时误报。\n  - 任一失败 → 503，响应体含失败项名，方便告警 Fanout。\n\n### P1.5 DEPLOY.md 微调\n\n- §2.3 `gcloud run deploy edm-backend` 参数加一行示例：`--set-env-vars=\"LOG_JSON=true,SENTRY_DSN=xxx,SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=prod\"`。\n- §4 docker-compose 的 healthcheck 样板从 `/health` 改 `/readyz`。\n- 新增 §11 空壳子章节（P2 填内容），标注\"可观测性见 §11\"。\n\n---\n\n## P2 · 可见面（知道正在发生什么 + 出事能自动 @on-call）\n\n目标：不再\"事后 `GET /reports/overview`\"；AI token 花销 / 发信漏斗 / 队列积压在 Cloud Monitoring 上可视化；`hard_stop` 触发自动打人。\n\n### P2.1 后端 Prometheus `/metrics`\n\n- `edm-backend/requirements.in` 追加：\n  - `prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.0`（拿 HTTP 四元 + 自动暴露 `/metrics`）\n  - `prometheus-client>=0.20`（业务 Counter/Histogram）\n- 新建 `edm-backend/app/core/metrics.py`，集中定义业务指标：\n  - `edm_send_total = Counter(\"edm_send_total\", ..., [\"status\"])`（status ∈ sent / bounced / dropped / failed / delivered）\n  - `edm_send_rate_per_sec = Gauge(...)`（pacer tick 时 `.set(current_rate)`）\n  - `edm_ai_latency_seconds = Histogram(..., [\"agent\", \"provider\"])`\n  - `edm_ai_retry_total = Counter(..., [\"code\", \"provider\"])`（code ∈ 429 / 5xx / validator / timeout）\n  - `edm_ai_tokens_total = Counter(..., [\"provider\", \"model\", \"kind\"])`（kind ∈ prompt / completion）\n  - `edm_queue_depth = Gauge(..., [\"queue\"])`\n  - `edm_dispatch_lag_seconds = Histogram(...)`\n- `main.py` 初始化：\n\n``​`python\nfrom prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator import Instrumentator\nInstrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app, endpoint=\"/metrics\", include_in_schema=False)\n``​`\n\n### P2.2 业务埋点（5 处改动）\n\n- [`edm-backend/app/ai_providers/base.py`](edm-backend/app/ai_providers/base.py) `_post_completion`：读到 `usage` 后 inc `edm_ai_tokens_total`，`time.perf_counter()` 差值 observe `edm_ai_latency_seconds`（agent 标签由 caller 传入，`_post_completion` 先接受可选 `agent: str | None`，默认 `\"unknown\"`）。\n- [`edm-backend/app/ai_providers/circuit_breaker.py`](edm-backend/app/ai_providers/circuit_breaker.py)：重试/breaker 跳闸处 `edm_ai_retry_total.labels(code=..., provider=...).inc()`。\n- [`edm-backend/app/services/send_service.py`](edm-backend/app/services/send_service.py)：SendLog status 迁移的那几处 update 后 `edm_send_total.labels(status).inc()`。\n- [`edm-backend/app/services/send_pacer.py`](edm-backend/app/services/send_pacer.py)：ramp tick 处 `.set()` 当前 rate 到 `edm_send_rate_per_sec`。\n- [`edm-backend/app/services/send_service.py`](edm-backend/app/services/send_service.py) 的 `_dispatch_loop`：每 tick `edm_queue_depth.labels(\"send\").set(qsize)`；`dispatch_lag = now - task.scheduled_at` observe 到 `edm_dispatch_lag_seconds`。\n\n> **重要**：worker 进程是多 Python 对象的，Cloud Run 的 concurrency=1 worker 下 prometheus-client 默认的 `MultiProcessMode` 不需要开。但 HTTP Service 那边 gunicorn 多 worker 时必须开 `PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR`，否则 /metrics 只看得到一个 worker 的计数。[`edm-backend/scripts/entrypoint.sh`](edm-backend/scripts/entrypoint.sh) 里启动 gunicorn 前要 `export PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR=/tmp/prom` 并建目录。\n\n### P2.3 前端 Sentry + source map\n\n- [`edm-frontend/package.json`](edm-frontend/package.json) 加：\n  - `\"@sentry/react\": \"^8.40.0\"`\n  - `\"@sentry/vite-plugin\": \"^2.22.0\"`（devDep）\n- [`edm-frontend/vite.config.ts`](edm-frontend/vite.config.ts) 加 `build.sourcemap: true` + `sentryVitePlugin({ org, project, authToken: process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN })`（只在 `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` 存在时启用，本地 build 不需要）。\n- [`edm-frontend/src/main.tsx`](edm-frontend/src/main.tsx) 第 1 行：`Sentry.init({...})`，DSN 走 `import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN`，带 `browserTracingIntegration` + `replayIntegration`，`replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0` / `replaysSessionSampleRate: 0.0`（只回放错误的）。\n- `.env.production.example` 加占位 `VITE_SENTRY_DSN=` + `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=` + `SENTRY_ORG=` + `SENTRY_PROJECT=`（后三者只在 CI）。\n\n### P2.4 Cloud Monitoring 告警（写进 DEPLOY.md §11）\n\n- `/metrics` 接入：推荐 Cloud Run + **Managed Service for Prometheus**，给 `edm-backend` 和 `edm-worker` 都加 `cloudresourcemanager/monitoring.googleapis.com/prometheus_target` 注解，让 GMP 每 30s 拉一次。\n- 告警 policy 样板（用 `gcloud alpha monitoring policies create` 或 Terraform，DEPLOY.md 给出 YAML）：\n  - **HTTP 5xx rate > 1%（5 min 窗口）** → 触发 PagerDuty/企微 webhook\n  - **`edm_send_total{status=\"bounced\"}` rate / 总 rate > 2%（15 min）** → 告警\n  - **`edm_ai_retry_total{code=\"429\"}` rate 突增** → 告警（防 API fee 炸）\n  - **Log-based alert：`SendTask auto-paused` 关键字** → 日志告警 policy（send_monitor 已经打了这行 WARNING，P1 改 JSON 后可以直接按字段过滤）\n  - **Sentry error rate**：Sentry 内部自带，通过 Sentry→Slack/企微集成走\n- 给出复制即用的 `alert-policy.yaml` 样板 3 条（5xx / bounce / hard_stop log）。\n\n### P2.5 Token 花销日报（可选增强）\n\nAI_content / AI_translate 单价差一个量级，单独 `edm_ai_tokens_total` 还不够直观：\n\n- 新建 `edm-backend/app/services/ai_cost_reporter.py`，APScheduler 每 24h 跑：按 provider/model 聚合 tokens × 单价表，打一条 `logger.info(\"ai_cost_daily\", extra={...})`。\n- 单价表先硬编码在 `app/ai_providers/pricing.py`（OpenAI / DeepSeek / Gemini 公开价，每半年人工对齐一次）。\n- 不做 metric 暴露，只靠 JSON 日志 → Cloud Logging → BigQuery sink 做历史回溯（有需要再补）。\n\n---\n\n## 不做 / 不动\n\n- **`app/services/trace_store.py` 零改动**，名字雷同但职责不同，和 OpenTelemetry 正交。\n- **不上 OpenTelemetry OTLP**：用户已选 Sentry + Prometheus 方案，OTLP 与 Cloud Trace 的整合留作后续考虑。\n- **不自己造 Datadog agent 镜像**：用户方案 A 不走 Datadog。\n- **不动现有 `logger.exception` 语义**：LoggingIntegration 自动把 ERROR 级别日志上 Sentry，业务代码无需修改。\n\n## 回退\n\n- Sentry DSN 清空 → 后端/前端完全 no-op，和现在行为一致。\n- `LOG_JSON=false` → formatter 走纯文本（开发态默认）。\n- 去除 `prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator` 的 `instrument(app)` 调用 → `/metrics` 404，埋点代码不跑（`Counter.inc()` 即使不 scrape 也是 no-op）。\n\n## 交付物快览\n\n- 后端新增 3 个文件：`app/core/request_context.py` / `app/core/sentry_init.py` / `app/core/middleware.py` / `app/core/metrics.py`（P2）\n- 后端修改 6 个文件：`config.py` / `main.py` / `logging_config.py` / `ai_providers/base.py` / `services/send_service.py` / `services/send_pacer.py`\n- 前端修改 3 个文件：`package.json` / `vite.config.ts` / `src/main.tsx`\n- 文档：`DEPLOY.md` §11 新增可观测性章节 + `alert-policy.yaml` 样板 + `.env.production.example`\n",

 "contents": "\"\"\"Data-lifecycle retention policies — one row per large table.\n\nThis is the **single source of truth** for \"how long do we keep rows in\neach big table?\" It deliberately avoids sprinkling magic numbers across\nthe codebase so retention becomes an env-tunable, operator-visible\nknob instead of a buried constant.\n\nDesign choices:\n\n* :class:`RetentionPolicy` is a frozen dataclass. Mutating a policy at\n  runtime is almost never the right move — changing retention should go\n  through a config / deploy cycle, not a monkey-patch.\n\n* ``settings_key`` names the ``app.config.Settings`` field that can\n  override ``default_days`` via env var. A more conservative / more\n  aggressive retention window on a specific table is an **env change,\n  not a code change**. Leaving ``settings_key`` as ``None`` means the\n  default is hard-coded (used for tables we never expect to re-tune).\n\n* ``cascade_note`` documents how the deletion interacts with SQL\n  foreign-key CASCADEs. The sweep CLI consumes this as prose for its\n  ``--help`` / ``--json`` output, and operators reading DB migrations\n  can cross-reference it.\n\n* **``unsubscribes`` is intentionally NOT listed here.** The Yahoo\n  bulk-sender / CAN-SPAM guidance is \"honour unsubscribes for at least\n  two years\" and operationally we re-consent users only after an\n  explicit opt-in flow, so \"永不删\" is the safer posture. Must match ``Model.__tablename__``.\n        time_column: Column whose value we compare against ``cutoff =\n            now - days``. Typically ``created_at`` from\n            :class:`app.models.base.Base`; ``webhook_events`` overrides\n            to ``received_at`` because that's the field the dedup\n            index is built on.\n        default_days: Fallback retention window when no env override is\n            present.\n        settings_key: Name of the override field on\n            :class:`app.config.Settings`. ``None`` means \"no env\n            override, always use default\".\n        cascade_note: Human-readable note about FK cascade behaviour —\n            consumed by the CLI's ``--help`` and dry-run output so the\n            on-call operator sees *why* this table is special.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    table: str\n    time_column: str\n    default_days: int\n    settings_key: str | None = None\n    cascade_note: str = \"\"\n\n    def effective_days(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Resolve ``default_days`` against the env override.\n\n        Returns the override from :mod:`app.config.settings` when that\n        field exists and is a positive int; otherwise the default.\n        Zero / negative values on the settings field fall back to the\n        default to protect against ``RETENTION_X_DAYS=0`` inadvertently\n        deleting everything.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.settings_key:\n            return self.default_days\n        override = getattr(settings, self.settings_key, None)\n        if isinstance(override, int) and override > 0:\n            return override\n        return self.default_days\n\n\n#: Canonical policy tuple. Order is irrelevant for lookup but matters\n#: for the sweep CLI — :func:`sweep_order` re-orders these so FK\n#: children are deleted before their parents (avoids a single large\n#: CASCADE when ``agent_runs`` gets cleaned).\nPOLICIES: tuple[RetentionPolicy, ...] = (\n    RetentionPolicy(\n        \"agent_events\",\n        \"created_at\",\n        60,\n        \"RETENTION_AGENT_EVENTS_DAYS\",\n        \"FK CASCADE on agent_runs (child — purge before parent)\",\n    ),\n    RetentionPolicy(\n        \"agent_steps\",\n        \"created_at\",\n        90,\n        \"RETENTION_AGENT_STEPS_DAYS\",\n        \"FK CASCADE on agent_runs (child — purge before parent)\",\n    ),\n    RetentionPolicy(\n        \"agent_runs\",\n        \"created_at\",\n        365,\n        \"RETENTION_AGENT_RUNS_DAYS\",\n        \"DELETE cascades to agent_events / agent_steps — sweep CLI \"\n        \"explicitly deletes children by run_id before the parent to \"\n        \"avoid a single multi-million-row CASCADE transaction.\",\n    ),\n    RetentionPolicy(\n        \"tracking_events\",\n        \"created_at\",\n        180,\n        \"RETENTION_TRACKING_EVENTS_DAYS\",\n        \"No FK cascade; bulky — batched delete keeps WAL small.\",\n    ),\n    RetentionPolicy(\n        \"send_logs\",\n        \"created_at\",\n        180,\n        \"RETENTION_SEND_LOGS_DAYS\",\n        \"FK CASCADE on send_tasks (children) — rarely relevant because \"\n        \"send_tasks themselves are kept by business lifecycle, not time.\",\n    ),\n    RetentionPolicy(\n        \"webhook_events\",\n        \"received_at\",\n        30,\n        \"RETENTION_WEBHOOK_EVENTS_DAYS\",\n        \"Idempotency ledger — 30 days is more than enough since Tencent \"\n        \"SES only retries for up to 24h.\",\n    ),\n)\n\n\n#: Set of table names that are **protected** from any retention sweep,\n#: regardless of CLI flags. Kept in sync with the red lines in the plan:\n#: ``unsubscribes`` is compliance-critical and must never be time-based\n#: purged.\nPROTECTED_TABLES: frozenset[str] = frozenset({\n    \"unsubscribes\",\n    \"users\",\n    \"campaigns\",\n    \"campaign_contents\",\n    \"campaign_segments\",\n    \"templates\",\n    \"recipients\",\n    \"recipient_lists\",\n    \"send_tasks\",\n    \"sender_health\",\n    \"sender_baseline\",\n})\n\n\ndef policy_for(table: str) -> RetentionPolicy | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the policy entry for *table*, or ``None`` when no match.\"\"\"\n    for p in POLICIES:\n        if p.table == table:\n            return p\n    return None\n\n\ndef sweep_order() -> tuple[RetentionPolicy, ...]:\n    \"\"\"Return policies ordered so FK-children are purged before parents.\n\n    ``agent_events`` + ``agent_steps`` are FK children of ``agent_runs``\n    with ``ondelete=CASCADE``. If the sweep deletes ``agent_runs`` rows\n    first, Postgres emits one giant CASCADE DELETE per batch that can\n    put millions of child rows into a single WAL record. }

The\nretention window per table lives in\n:mod:`app.services.retention_policy`; the CLI here just reads that\nconfig and does the actual work.\n\nUsage::\n\n    cd edm-backend\n\n    # Dry-run every table (default — just counts, nothing is deleted).\n    python -m scripts.retention_sweep\n\n    # Real delete across every policy table in the FK-safe order.\n    python -m scripts.retention_sweep --apply\n\n    # Single table only.\n    python -m scripts.retention_sweep --table tracking_events --apply\n\n    # Archive each batch as Parquet to gs://... BEFORE deleting.\n    python -m scripts.retention_sweep --apply \\\n        --archive-to gs://edm-cold-archive/retention\n\n    # Smaller batches (e.g. when Postgres replication lag is tight).\n    python -m scripts.retention_sweep --apply --batch-size 1000\n\n    # NDJSON log output (easy to feed into Cloud Logging / jq).\n    python -m scripts.retention_sweep --apply --json\n\nKey design notes:\n\n* **Dry-run is the default** (matches the seed_bootstrap idempotent-\n  first-run ethos). You have to opt in to deletion via ``--apply``. The\n  script prints the same \"scanned\" counter in both modes so the\n  operator always sees impact before committing.\n\n* **Batched DELETE, one transaction per batch.** A single ``DELETE\n  FROM huge_table WHERE created_at < cutoff`` on Postgres holds a\n  multi-million-row lock, blows out WAL, and jams VACUUM. Whoever adds a new\n# policy also has to register the model binding here.\n_TABLE_MODELS: dict[str, tuple[Any, Any]] = {\n    \"agent_events\": (AgentEvent, AgentEvent.created_at),\n    \"agent_steps\": (AgentStep, AgentStep.created_at),\n    \"agent_runs\": (AgentRun, AgentRun.created_at),\n    \"tracking_events\": (TrackingEvent, TrackingEvent.created_at),\n    \"send_logs\": (SendLog, SendLog.created_at),\n    \"webhook_events\": (WebhookEvent, WebhookEvent.received_at),\n}\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _utc_now() -> datetime:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n\n\ndef _parse_gcs_url(url: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Split ``gs://bucket/optional/prefix`` into ``(bucket, prefix)``.\n\n    Prefix is empty-string when the URL has no path component. Raises\n    ``ValueError`` for anything that isn't a valid gs:// URL so we fail\n    fast instead of silently uploading to the wrong place.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not url.startswith(\"gs://\"):\n        raise ValueError(f\"Archive URL must start with gs://, got {url!r}\")\n    path = url[len(\"gs://\"):]\n    bucket, _, prefix = path.partition(\"/\")\n    if not bucket:\n        raise ValueError(f\"Missing bucket in archive URL {url!r}\")\n    return bucket, prefix.strip(\"/\")\n\n\ndef _row_to_pylist_entry(row: Any, model: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Serialize one ORM row to a Parquet-friendly dict.\n\n    Heterogeneous JSON columns (``AgentStep.input_json`` / ``.output_json``\n    etc.) would otherwise force pyarrow into a brittle StructType union;\n    serializing to JSON text keeps the Parquet schema stable across\n    runs. ``datetime`` is stringified to ISO-8601 for the same reason.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    for col in model.__table__.columns:\n        val = getattr(row, col.name, None)\n        if isinstance(val, (dict, list)):\n            out[col.name] = json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)\n        elif isinstance(val, datetime):\n            out[col.name] = val.isoformat()\n        else:\n            out[col.name] = val\n    return out\n\n\ndef _archive_batch_to_gcs(\n    rows: list[Any],\n    model: Any,\n    *,\n    bucket: str,\n    prefix: str,\n    table: str,\n    cutoff_date: str,\n    batch_num: int,\n) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Upload one batch of rows as Parquet to GCS.\n\n    Path layout: ``gs://<bucket>/<prefix>/<table>/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/\n    part-NNNN.parquet``. Returns the row count that was uploaded.\n    Any failure raises — callers MUST treat that as a hard abort and\n    not continue with the DELETE for the same batch.\n\n    ``pyarrow`` and ``google-cloud-storage`` are imported lazily so the\n    script has no hard dependency on them when ``--archive-to`` isn't\n    set.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not rows:\n        return 0\n\n    import io\n\n    import pyarrow as pa\n    import pyarrow.parquet as pq\n    from google.cloud import storage\n\n    row_dicts = [_row_to_pylist_entry(r, model) for r in rows]\n    pa_table = pa.Table.from_pylist(row_dicts)\n\n    buf = io.BytesIO()\n    pq.write_table(pa_table, buf)\n    buf.seek(0)\n\n    key_parts = [p for p in (prefix, table, f\"dt={cutoff_date}\", f\"part-{batch_num:04d}.parquet\") if p]\n    key = \"/\".join(key_parts)\n\n    client = storage.Client()\n    blob = client.bucket(bucket).blob(key)\n    blob.upload_from_file(buf, content_type=\"application/octet-stream\")\n\n    logger.debug(\n        \"retention_sweep: archived batch | table=%s batch=%d key=gs://%s/%s rows=%d\",\n        table, batch_num, bucket, key, len(rows),\n    )\n    return len(rows)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# DB primitives\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\nasync def _scan_count(\n    db: AsyncSession, model: Any, time_col: Any, cutoff: datetime\n) -> int:\n    stmt = select(func.count()).select_from(model).where(time_col < cutoff)\n    return int((await db.execute(stmt)).scalar() or 0)\n\n\nasync def _fetch_batch_ids(\n    db: AsyncSession, model: Any, time_col: Any, cutoff: datetime, batch_size: int\n) -> list[str]:\n    stmt = select(model.id).where(time_col < cutoff).limit(batch_size)\n    return list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())\n\n\nasync def _fetch_batch_rows(db: AsyncSession, model: Any, ids: list[str]) -> list[Any]:\n    stmt = select(model).where(model.id.in_(ids))\n    return list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())\n\n\nasync def _delete_by_ids(db: AsyncSession, model: Any, ids: list[str]) -> int:\n    result = await db.execute(delete(model).where(model.id.in_(ids)))\n    return int(result.rowcount or 0)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Sweep core\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\nasync def sweep_table(\n    policy: RetentionPolicy,\n    *,\n    apply: bool,\n    archive_to: str | None,\n    batch_size: int,\n    cutoff_override: datetime | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Run a retention sweep for exactly one table.\n\n    Args:\n        policy: Retention policy for this table.\n        apply: When ``False`` (the default for dry-run), count affected\n            rows but don't delete.\n        archive_to: ``gs://bucket/prefix`` URL; when set, each batch is\n :func:`sweep_table`.\n        batch_size: Rows per DELETE batch.\n        cutoff_override: Force the cutoff datetime for every table —\n            test-only knob; production callers must leave this dicts) / ``total_deleted`` /\n        ``total_archived`` / ``duration_ms``.\n    \"\"\"\n    if table is not None:\n        if table in PROTECTED_TABLES:\n            raise ValueError(\n retention policy for table {table!r}. \"\n                f\"Known policy tables: {known}\"\n            )\n        policies: tuple[RetentionPolicy, ...] = (pol,)\n    else:\n        policies = 4 个 todo 全部完成。下面是每项的落地摘要：

## 1. `policy_module` — `edm-backend/app/services/retention_policy.py`（新建）

- `RetentionPolicy`：`@dataclass(frozen=True)`，四列 `table / time_column / default_days / settings_key / cascade_note`。
- `effective_days()` 从 `settings` 读覆盖；非正数回退到 `default_days`（防 `RETENTION_X_DAYS=0` 误伤）。
- `POLICIES` 含 6 张表（`agent_events=60 / agent_steps=90 / agent_runs=365 / tracking_events=180 / send_logs=180 / webhook_events=30`）。
- `PROTECTED_TABLES` 显式列出 `unsubscribes`（以及其他业务实体），保证永远无法用"策略配置"的方式把它加进去——对应红线 #3。
- `sweep_order()` 返回"子表先，父表后"的顺序（`agent_events/agent_steps` 在 `agent_runs` 之前），防止 `agent_runs` 删除时触发 CASCADE 风暴。

## 2. `config_settings` — `edm-backend/app/config.py`

在 `LOG_LEVEL` 之前加了一整块 `Data lifecycle / retention sweep` 配置：

- 总开关：`RETENTION_ENABLED = True`
- 归档：`RETENTION_ARCHIVE_GCS_URL = ""`（生产填 `gs://edm-cold-archive/retention`）
- 批次：`RETENTION_BATCH_SIZE = 5000`
- 每日时点：`RETENTION_DAILY_HOUR_UTC = 3`
- 6 张表各自的 `RETENTION_*_DAYS` 默认值与 `POLICIES` 一致。

验证过 `pydantic-settings` 通过环境变量覆盖生效：`RETENTION_TRACKING_EVENTS_DAYS=90` → `policy_for("tracking_events").effective_days() == 90`。

## 3. `sweep_cli` — `edm-backend/scripts/retention_sweep.py`（新建）

- CLI：`--apply`（默认 dry-run）/ `--table` / `--archive-to` / `--batch-size`（默认读 `settings.RETENTION_BATCH_SIZE`）/ `--json`。
- 核心函数 `sweep_all(apply, table, archive_to, batch_size, cutoff_override)` 供 scheduler 直接 `await`。
- **分页删除**：每个 batch 独立 `async_session_factory()` / `commit()`，通过 `select(Model.id).where(time_col < cutoff).limit(batch_size)` + `delete(Model).where(Model.id.in_(ids))` 滚动推进，WAL 压力可控。
- **FK 优先**：`policy.table == "agent_runs"` 时，每个 batch 先 `delete(AgentEvent).where(run_id.in_(ids))` + `delete(AgentStep).where(run_id.in_(ids))`，再删父行（红线 #1）。
- **归档**：`--archive-to gs://bucket/prefix` 时每批先写 Parquet → `gs://bucket/prefix/<table>/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/part-NNNN.parquet`。`pyarrow` / `google-cloud-storage` lazy import，仅在触发归档时载入。上传失败直接 `raise` 终止本轮 sweep，不会继续删（红线 #2）。
- **保护机制**：`--table unsubscribes` / 任何 `PROTECTED_TABLES` 条目在 CLI 层面就 `return 2` 拒绝，`sweep_all` 内部再做一次防御。
- **启动期一致性检查**：`_TABLE_MODELS` 缺任何一张 `POLICIES` 中的表会在 import 时 `RuntimeError`——后续加新策略但忘了注册 ORM 绑定，03:00 UTC 之前就会炸。
- **输出**：默认人类可读表格，`--json` 输出 NDJSON（`sweep_start` / `sweep_table` × N / `sweep_done`）便于 Cloud Logging + `jq` 抓取。
- 本地 SQLite 冒烟：`python -m scripts.retention_sweep --table agent_events --json`、`--table send_logs`、`--help`、`--table unsubscribes` 拒绝、`--table nonexistent_table` 拒绝，全部如期工作。

## 4. `scheduler_job` — `edm-backend/app/services/scheduler.py`

- 新增 `run_retention_sweep()` async 函数：`RETENTION_ENABLED=false` 直接 no-op；否则 lazy-import `scripts.retention_sweep.sweep_all(apply=True, archive_to=settings.RETENTION_ARCHIVE_GCS_URL or None, batch_size=settings.RETENTION_BATCH_SIZE)`。
- 异常一律 `logger.exception("retention_sweep tick crashed")` 吞掉，保证 scheduler 后续 tick 不被前一次崩溃带坏。
- 日志既输出整轮汇总（`total_deleted / total_archived / duration_ms / archive_to / batch_size`），又逐表打印（对齐 plan §7 的验收指标 "`retention_sweep tick | {tracking_events: deleted=N, ...}`"）。
- 在 `start_scheduler()` 里用 `cron` 触发器注册：`hour=settings.RETENTION_DAILY_HOUR_UTC, minute=0, timezone="UTC"`，`coalesce=True` + `misfire_grace_time=3600`（worker 重启如果错过整点，1 小时内补跑一次就行，不会越过日窗补多次）。
- 头部 module docstring 从"Four periodic jobs"更新为"Five"，把新 job 描述进去。
- `start_scheduler()` 收尾日志把 `retention_sweep=HH:00Z (enabled=...)` 加进去，便于开机时就能在日志里确认 cron 点位。

- `ReadLints` 对 4 个文件全部 0 错误。
- 模块导入：`from app.services.scheduler import run_retention_sweep` / `from app.services.retention_policy import POLICIES, PROTECTED_TABLES, sweep_order, policy_for` / `from app.config import settings`（10 个新字段）—— 全部 OK。

 "contents": "\"\"\"CSV download helpers shared by every ``export.csv`` endpoint.\n\nTwo flavours of downloader live here:\n\n* :func:`csv_response` materialises a bounded ``list[dict]`` into a single\n  in-memory ``StreamingResponse``. Use this for report summaries where the\n  row count is known-small (``overview`` / ``events`` / single-campaign\n  recipient export).\n\n* :func:`streaming_csv_response` yields rows one at a time from an async\n  generator, so 500k-row RecipientList exports won't OOM the worker —\n  the caller is responsible for paginating the DB read inside the\n  generator (typically with ``OFFSET / LIMIT`` in ≥1k row batches, see\n  ``app.api.recipients.export_list_csv`` for the reference pattern).\n\nBoth emit UTF-8 with a BOM so Excel opens the file as UTF-8 instead of\nfalling back to the system ANSI code page (the 中文 garble everybody\nhas hit once). The BOM is written manually on the streaming path since\nwe can't rely on ``.encode(\"utf-8-sig\")`` mid-stream — it would emit the\nBOM on every chunk.\n\nThe module lives under ``app/utils`` (not ``app/api``) so any router can\nimport it without a circular-import risk — the dependency rule is\n\"utils → services/models, never utils → api\".\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterable, Sequence\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse\n\n_UTF8_BOM = \"\\ufeff\"\n\n\ndef csv_response(\n    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],\n    *,\n    filename: str,\n) -> StreamingResponse:\n    \"\"\"Serialise ``rows`` into a single-shot CSV download.\n\n    ``rows`` must contain at least one entry — callers should short-circuit\n    to a 404 when the underlying query is empty rather than emit an empty\n    file (matches the existing ``reports.py`` contract).\n\n    The field order is taken from ``rows[0].keys()``; every row is expected\n    to share the same shape. Raises ``ValueError`` on empty input so the\n    failure is loud rather than a silent empty-body response.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not rows:\n        raise ValueError(\n            \"csv_response() called with an empty row list — short-circuit \"\n            \"to 404 / 204 upstream instead of emitting an empty download.\"\n        )\n\n    output = io.StringIO()\n    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys()))\n    writer.writeheader()\n    writer.writerows(rows)\n    content = output.getvalue().encode(\"utf-8-sig\")\n    return StreamingResponse(\n        io.BytesIO(content),\n        media_type=\"text/csv\",\n        headers={\n            \"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{filename}\"',\n        },\n    )\n\n\ndef streaming_csv_response(\n    *,\n    fieldnames: Sequence[str],\n    rows: AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] | Iterable[dict[str, Any]],\n    filename: str,\n) -> StreamingResponse:\n    \"\"\"Streaming CSV download for exports whose row count could be huge.\n\n    ``rows`` is an async *or* sync iterator of homogeneous dicts whose keys\n    match ``fieldnames``. We emit the BOM + header on the first chunk and\n    then one CSV line per row — ``StreamingResponse`` flushes each yielded\n    ``bytes`` payload straight to the client, so memory usage stays ~O(1)\n    in the row count.\n\n    Missing keys are rendered as empty strings (``DictWriter`` default\n    via ``extrasaction=\"ignore\"``), which is safer than raising mid-stream\n    — partial downloads with a broken row leave the operator guessing.\n\n    Callers must guarantee the iterator owns its own DB session lifetime\n    or otherwise avoids \"session closed mid-iteration\" errors. The typical\n    pattern is a server-side paginated loop inside the generator itself,\n    each page running ``await db.execute(... LIMIT N OFFSET k)`` so the\n    DB connection is released between batches.\n    \"\"\"\n    field_list = list(fieldnames)\n\n    async def _aiter() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:\n        header_buf = io.StringIO()\n        header_buf.write(_UTF8_BOM)\n        csv.DictWriter(\n            header_buf, fieldnames=field_list, extrasaction=\"ignore\",\n        ).writeheader()\n        yield header_buf.getvalue().encode(\"utf-8\")\n\n        if hasattr(rows, \"__aiter__\"):\n            async for row in rows:  # type: ignore[union-attr]\n                yield _serialize_row(row, field_list)\n        else:\n            for row in rows:  # type: ignore[union-attr]\n                yield _serialize_row(row, field_list)\n\n    return StreamingResponse(\n        _aiter(),\n        media_type=\"text/csv\",\n        headers={\n            \"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{filename}\"',\n        },\n    )\n\n\ndef _serialize_row(row: dict[str, Any], fieldnames: list[str]) -> bytes:\n    buf = io.StringIO()\n    writer = csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction=\"ignore\")\n    writer.writerow(row)\n    return buf.getvalue().encode(\"utf-8\")\n"
}

I'm realizing that while the Recipient model uses UUID hex strings for the `id` field, keyset pagination based on `id` ordering would be deterministic and stable even though UUIDs aren't insertion-sequential like auto-incrementing integers would be.

For the actual query, I need `WHERE list_id = ? AND id > ? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000`, which requires an index on `(list_id, id)`. The existing indices like `ix_recipient_list_segment` start with `list_id` but don't include `id`, so I should verify whether SQLAlchemy automatically creates a foreign key index or if I need to explicitly define a covering index for this pagination pattern to be efficient. ORDER BY id`, Postgres would use one of the `list_id` indices to fetch all rows then filter by `id` — not ideal.

Let me just use OFFSET/LIMIT for simplicity. The trade-off is real but the order-by-id path wouldn't benefit from existing indices anyway.

Wait — actually, there's the primary key index on `id`, and for the filter `WHERE list_id = ?` we have `(list_id, segment/group/lang)` indices. The plan-level would be: fetch all rows matching `list_id` using the `ix_recipient_list_segment` (or similar) index prefix, then apply `OFFSET K LIMIT N`. In practice Postgres will probably do a Bitmap Heap Scan on one of the `list_id` indices.

OFFSET K is O(K) — it still has to walk through K rows. For 500k rows with 1000-row batches, the last batch would OFFSET 499000 — walked 499k rows. That's cumulative work: 0 + 1000 + 2000 + ... + 499000 = 500*499*1000/2 = ~125B row walks. That's bad.

Keyset pagination is correct. Let me go with `WHERE list_id = ? AND id > ? ORDER BY id LIMIT N`. Without a dedicated `(list_id, id)` index, Postgres would still use the `list_id` prefix of any of the three composite indices, which is not great.

I should use server-side cursors with `stream()` to avoid materializing everything in memory — SQLAlchemy's `AsyncSession.stream()` returns an async iterator that fetches rows as they're consumed, and with `yield_per(1000)` it batches efficiently.

But there's a gotcha: FastAPI closes the session after the view function returns, but `StreamingResponse` iterates the body after that, so the session is already gone. The cleanest fix is to create a separate session directly inside the generator function rather than relying on the dependency injection.

Setting up the pattern now: verify the list exists first (so we can return a 404 before streaming starts), then open a fresh session inside the async generator to stream rows with server-side cursors.

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\utils\\download.ts",
 "contents": "/**\n * Authenticated file download helpers.\n *\n * CSV export endpoints like ``/api/recipients/lists/{id}/export.csv`` are\n * gated on the same ``Bearer <edm_token>`` as the rest of the API, so we\n * can't just drop an ``<a href>`` on the page — browsers don't attach\n * the Authorization header when navigating a raw link. Instead, we fetch\n * the URL manually with the token, hand the returned stream to a Blob,\n * and trigger a synthetic ``<a download>`` click.\n *\n * The Blob path does buffer the full response in memory once it arrives\n * on the client — that's acceptable: the browser tab is the OOM\n * boundary, not the backend worker. Even a 50M-row list compressed is\n * well under the typical 1-2 GB browser tab budget.\n */\n\nexport interface DownloadAuthedOptions {\n  /** Extra query string appended as-is (without leading ``?``). */\n  queryString?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Download ``url`` as a file with the given ``filename``.\n *\n * Throws ``Error`` with a user-readable message on non-2xx responses —\n * callers should wrap in a try/catch and show ``message.error(err)``.\n */\nexport async function downloadAuthedFile(\n  url: string,\n  filename: string,\n  opts: DownloadAuthedOptions = {},\n): Promise<void> {\n  const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n  const finalUrl = opts.queryString\n    ? `${url}${url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}${opts.queryString}`\n    : url;\n\n  const resp = await fetch(finalUrl, {\n    method: 'GET',\n    headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},\n  });\n\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    let detail = `下载失败（HTTP ${resp.status}）`;\n    try {\n      const ct = resp.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';\n      if (ct.includes('application/json')) {\n        const data = await resp.json();\n        if (typeof data?.detail === 'string') detail = data.detail;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // 非 JSON 响应，保留默认 detail —— 400/401/403/404 常见\n    }\n    throw new Error(detail);\n  }\n\n  const blob = await resp.blob();\n  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n  const anchor = document.createElement('a');\n  anchor.href = objectUrl;\n  anchor.download = filename;\n  document.body.appendChild(anchor);\n  anchor.click();\n  document.body.removeChild(anchor);\n  URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);\n}\n"
}

Run Job + Cloud Scheduler 触发。把生产 DB\n# 的逻辑备份上传到 GCS 冷存 bucket，作为 Cloud SQL 自动快照的兜底（自动快照\n# 只能救同项目同实例；这份 pg_dump 可以跨项目 / 跨 region 恢复，参见\n# DEPLOY.md §7.5）。\n#\n# 流水线：\n#   1. `pg_dump --no-owner --no-acl --format=custom` 输出到 /tmp。\n#      —— 注：DEPLOY.md 早期版本写的 `--jobs=2` 在 `--format=custom` 下\n#      不支持（pg_dump 只允许 `--format=directory` 并行）。这里保守走单线\n#      程自定义格式，出一个整体文件，`pg_restore -j N` 还原时再并行。\n#      自定义格式已经自带 zlib 压缩，不必再 `| gzip`。\n#   2. `gsutil cp` 到 gs://$GCS_BACKUP_BUCKET/pg_dump/YYYY-MM-DD/edm.dump，\n#      外加一份 gs://…/pg_dump/latest/edm.dump 方便 on-call 随手拉最新。\n#   3. 清理 GCS 目录名 < (now − RETENTION_BACKUP_DAYS) 的旧备份。按日期字符串\n#      比较（YYYY-MM-DD 字典序即时间序），不依赖 GCS 对象 mtime —— Cloud\n#      Storage 的 lifecycle rule 也会做这件事，脚本里再清一次是双重保险。\n#\n# 失败策略：任何一步非零即 `set -e` 退出非零，Cloud Run Job 会把本次\n# execution 标 Failed，Cloud Logging 里 severity>=ERROR 可以直接报警。\n#\n# 必填环境变量：\n#   GCS_BACKUP_BUCKET      — 目标 bucket 名（不含 gs:// 前缀）\n#   PGHOST / PGUSER / PGDATABASE / PGPASSWORD\n#                          — libpq 标准变量（见 DEPLOY.md §7.5.3 的 Job env）\n#                            也可以改用 DATABASE_URL（支持 SQLAlchemy 的\n#                            `postgresql+asyncpg://...` 格式，脚本会剥掉\n#                            `+asyncpg` 前缀再交给 pg_dump）\n#\n# 可选环境变量：\n#   RETENTION_BACKUP_DAYS  — 保留天数，默认 90\n#   PG_DUMP_EXTRA_OPTS     — 追加给 pg_dump 的参数（比如 `-v -Z 9`）\n#   GCS_LATEST_ALIAS       — 是否额外写 `pg_dump/latest/` 软符号，默认 true\n# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\n# ── 环境变量检查 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n: \"${GCS_BACKUP_BUCKET:?GCS_BACKUP_BUCKET 必填（形如 edm-cold-backup，不含 gs:// 前缀）}\"\n: \"${RETENTION_BACKUP_DAYS:=90}\"\n: \"${PG_DUMP_EXTRA_OPTS:=}\"\n: \"${GCS_LATEST_ALIAS:=true}\"\n\n# GCS_BACKUP_BUCKET 允许用户不小心写成 gs://foo 或 gs://foo/ —— 统一剥干净。\nBUCKET=\"${GCS_BACKUP_BUCKET#gs://}\"\nBUCKET=\"${BUCKET%/}\"\n\n# 运行环境依赖检查（缺一不可，与其跑到一半失败不如提前挂掉）。\nfor bin in pg_dump gsutil date mktemp; do\n    if ! command -v \"$bin\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n        echo \"[backup] ERROR: required command '$bin' not found in PATH\" >&2\n        echo \"[backup]   Dockerfile 需要安装: postgresql-client, google-cloud-sdk\" >&2\n        exit 127\n    fi\ndone\n\n# 连接参数：优先级 PG* > DATABASE_URL。两者都没有时 pg_dump 会自己报错。\nDATABASE_URL_NATIVE=\"\"\nif [ -z \"${PGHOST:-}\" ] && [ -n \"${DATABASE_URL:-}\" ]; then\n    # SQLAlchemy 的 DATABASE_URL 形如 `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@host/db`，\n    # pg_dump 不认 +asyncpg / +psycopg 驱动后缀，剥掉变成 libpq 直接能用的格式。\n    DATABASE_URL_NATIVE=$(\n        printf '%s\\n' \"$DATABASE_URL\" |\n        sed -E 's|^postgresql\\+[a-z0-9]+://|postgresql://|; s|^postgres\\+[a-z0-9]+://|postgres://|'\n    )\nfi\n\n# ── 输出路径 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nTIMESTAMP=\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ)\"\nDATE_DIR=\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)\"\nWORKDIR=\"$(mktemp -d -t edm-backup-XXXXXX)\"\nDUMP_FILE=\"$WORKDIR/edm.dump\"\nGCS_DATED=\"gs://${BUCKET}/pg_dump/${DATE_DIR}/edm.dump\"\nGCS_LATEST=\"gs://${BUCKET}/pg_dump/latest/edm.dump\"\n\ncleanup() {\n    rm -rf \"$WORKDIR\"\n}\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\necho \"[backup] starting logical_backup at $TIMESTAMP\"\necho \"[backup]   bucket = ${BUCKET}\"\necho \"[backup]   dated  = ${GCS_DATED}\"\necho \"[backup]   retention = ${RETENTION_BACKUP_DAYS} days\"\n\n# ── 1) pg_dump ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\necho \"[backup] running pg_dump → ${DUMP_FILE}\"\nPG_DUMP_CMD=(\n    pg_dump\n    --no-owner\n    --no-acl\n    --format=custom\n    --file=\"${DUMP_FILE}\"\n)\n# shellcheck disable=SC2206  # PG_DUMP_EXTRA_OPTS 允许 word-split，是有意的\nPG_DUMP_CMD+=( ${PG_DUMP_EXTRA_OPTS} )\nif [ -n \"$DATABASE_URL_NATIVE\" ]; then\n    PG_DUMP_CMD+=( \"$DATABASE_URL_NATIVE\" )\nfi\n\n\"${PG_DUMP_CMD[@]}\"\n\n# 有些环境的 stat 是 BSD 版，没有 -c。按 GNU / BSD 各自的参数探测一次。\nif DUMP_BYTES=$(stat -c '%s' \"$DUMP_FILE\" 2>/dev/null); then\n    :  # GNU\nelse\n    DUMP_BYTES=$(stat -f '%z' \"$DUMP_FILE\")\nfi\necho \"[backup] pg_dump ok: size=${DUMP_BYTES} bytes\"\n\nif [ \"${DUMP_BYTES:-0}\" -lt 1024 ]; then\n    # 小于 1 KiB 几乎肯定是连接失败或空库，不能拿去覆盖 latest。\n    echo \"[backup] ERROR: dump too small (${DUMP_BYTES} bytes), aborting upload\" >&2\n    exit 2\nfi\n\n# ── 2) 上传到 GCS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\necho \"[backup] uploading → ${GCS_DATED}\"\ngsutil -q cp \"$DUMP_FILE\" \"$GCS_DATED\"\n\nif [ \"$GCS_LATEST_ALIAS\" = \"true\" ]; then\n    echo \"[backup] refreshing alias → ${GCS_LATEST}\"\n    gsutil -q cp \"$DUMP_FILE\" \"$GCS_LATEST\"\nfi\n\necho \"[backup] upload ok\"\n\n# ── 3) 轮转过期备份 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n# 用 GNU date 的 `-d` 算 cutoff 日期。BSD date 用 `-v` 语法，Cloud Run / debian\n# 镜像默认是 GNU。兼容 BSD 是防止有人在 macOS 本地手工跑脚本时困惑。\nCUTOFF_DATE=\"\"\nif CUTOFF_DATE=$(date -u -d \"-${RETENTION_BACKUP_DAYS} days\" +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null); then\n    :  # GNU\nelse\n    CUTOFF_DATE=$(date -u -v\"-${RETENTION_BACKUP_DAYS}d\" +%Y-%m-%d)\nfi\necho \"[backup] rotating old backups older than ${CUTOFF_DATE}\"\n\npruned=0\n# `gsutil ls` 列出所有子对象（目录名以 / 结尾）。grep -E '/$' 只保留目录。\n# 找不到任何子目录时 gsutil 会 exit 1，用 `|| true` 兜住，避免 set -e 中断。\nwhile IFS= read -r dir; do\n    [ -z \"$dir\" ] && continue\n    # 把 gs://bucket/pg_dump/2025-01-15/ 截成 2025-01-15\n    date_str=$(basename \"${dir%/}\")\n    if [ \"$date_str\" = \"latest\" ]; then\n        # latest/ 是轮询别名，永远不删\n        continue\n    fi\n    if ! [[ \"$date_str\" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then\n        echo \"[backup]   skipping non-date dir: $dir\"\n        continue\n    fi\n    if [[ \"$date_str\" < \"$CUTOFF_DATE\" ]]; then\n        echo \"[backup]   rm -r $dir (date=$date_str < ${CUTOFF_DATE})\"\n        if gsutil -m -q rm -r \"$dir\"; then\n            pruned=$((pruned + 1))\n        else\n            # 删失败就告警但继续跑 —— 今晚上不了也别把整个 job 拖 fail\n            echo \"[backup]   WARN: failed to delete $dir, continuing\" >&2\n        fi\n    fi\ndone < <(gsutil ls \"gs://${BUCKET}/pg_dump/\" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '/$' || true)\n\necho \"[backup] rotation done: pruned ${pruned} old directories\"\necho \"[backup] logical_backup completed at $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"\n"
}

## 实现总结

### 1. `csv_utils_extract` — 共用 CSV 响应工具
新建 `edm-backend/app/utils/__init__.py` + `edm-backend/app/utils/csv_response.py`，提供两个 helper：
- `csv_response(rows, *, filename)` — 小规模单次内存化导出（原 `reports.py::_csv_response` 搬家），空列表时 `ValueError` 硬失败，避免默默吐空文件。
- `streaming_csv_response(*, fieldnames, rows, filename)` — 支持 async/sync 迭代器的流式导出，手动写 UTF-8 BOM + 每行 yield，给大表场景兜底。

`app/api/reports.py` 改成 `from app.utils.csv_response import csv_response as _csv_response`，原本地函数定义删除，调用点完全不变。

### 2. `recipient_list_export` — `GET /recipients/lists/{list_id}/export.csv`
- 字段：`email, segment, group_id, lang, subscription_plan, registered_at, last_active_at, opened, clicked, sent_at`
- 先同步 `SELECT recipient_lists.id WHERE id = ?` 确认存在，不存在直接 404（不能让 `StreamingResponse` 先吐 200）
- 流式通道用 `async_session_factory()` **另开一条新 session**，原因写在端点 docstring：FastAPI 的 `Depends(get_db)` 在 view return 后立刻关闭 session，而 `StreamingResponse` 恰恰是 view return 之后才开始拉 generator；复用 request session 第一次 `async for` 就会 `session closed`。
- `db.stream(stmt.execution_options(yield_per=1000))` 配合后端 cursor，50w 行的 Recipient 表内存占用维持 O(1)。

### 3. `unsubscribe_export` — `GET /unsubscribes/export.csv`
- 字段：`email, campaign_id, reason, created_at`
- `Depends(require_admin)` 硬门，普通 token 403；合规（2 年 re-subscription 审计）场景只给管理员
- 与 RecipientList 端点同款 `async_session_factory` + `db.stream(yield_per=1000)` 流式骨架
- 按 `created_at DESC` 排序，跟 `GET /unsubscribes` 列表的默认顺序保持一致，下载的 CSV 和面板视图的「最新」口径不会打架

### 4. `frontend_buttons` — 两处导出按钮
- 新建 `edm-frontend/src/utils/download.ts::downloadAuthedFile(url, filename)`：带 `Bearer <edm_token>` 去 GET，失败时解包后端 `detail`，成功时走 Blob → `<a download>` 触发浏览器下载（plain `<a href>` 无法附 Authorization 头）。
- `UnsubscribeListPage.tsx`：Toolbar 增加「导出全部」按钮（`DownloadOutlined`），loading 状态隔离，admin/普通用户区分走 backend 的 403 detail 文案。

### 5. `logical_backup_script` — `edm-backend/scripts/logical_backup.sh`
- `set -euo pipefail` + `command -v` 前置检查 `pg_dump` / `gsutil` / `date` / `mktemp`，缺任一立刻 127 退出（比跑到一半失败体验好）
- 支持两种连参：`PGHOST/PGUSER/PGDATABASE/PGPASSWORD` 标准 libpq，或者 `DATABASE_URL`（自动剥 SQLAlchemy 的 `+asyncpg` / `+psycopg` 驱动后缀）
- `pg_dump --no-owner --no-acl --format=custom` 写到 `/tmp/edm-backup-XXXXXX/edm.dump`——说明里写了为何**不用 `--jobs=2`**：pg_dump 的 `--jobs` 只兼容 `--format=directory`（DEPLOY.md 早期文案与实际 pg_dump 行为不一致，这里走兼容实现，并在 pg_restore 时再并行还原）。自定义格式本身带 zlib 压缩，不再二次 `| gzip`。
- 产物 < 1 KiB 时视为 pg_dump 连上了空库或连接失败，拒绝覆盖 `latest/` 别名，防止污染兜底
- 双目标上传：`gs://<bucket>/pg_dump/YYYY-MM-DD/edm.dump` + `gs://<bucket>/pg_dump/latest/edm.dump`
- 轮转按**目录名的 YYYY-MM-DD 字符串字典序比较**（与时间序一致），GNU + BSD `date -d/-v` 都兼容；删除失败只 warn 不 fail，`latest/` 永不删
